Ship the exact reviewed change through risk-specific gates. Optimize for confidence per minute: never omit a required gate, and never repeat a gate that cannot add material evidence.

## 0. Operate as one delivery entrypoint

### Preserve the local-development boundary

Ordinary requests to implement, build, fix, change, continue, test, or QA a

do not authorize a commit, push, Pull Request, CI dispatch, merge, landing,

- `open a PR` authorizes the required scoped commit, branch push, and PR, not a

Rules for the receipt:

Cocokkan satu per satu intended behavior dengan actual behavior dan cari secara aktif bagian yang salah, kurang lengkap, berbeda dari requirement, keluar scope, duplicated, tidak konsisten, insecure, memiliki hidden dependency, atau berpotensi menyebabkan regression.

Lakukan QC dengan mindset **mencari cara implementasi bisa gagal**, bukan sekadar memastikan happy path bekerja. Periksa kondisi normal maupun edge case seperti invalid/missing input, null/undefined, empty data, malformed payload/response, invalid ID, duplicate data, repeated action, double-click/double-submit, retry, timeout, network failure, partial failure, refresh/reload, browser navigation, stale state, caching issue, race condition, asynchronous completion yang tidak berurutan, concurrent request, component/page berubah saat request aktif, permission/ownership failure, persistence failure, dan kondisi lain yang masuk akal berdasarkan flow fitur tersebut. Pastikan tidak ada duplicate execution, duplicate transaction, inconsistent state, data loss, orphan record, false success, silent failure, infinite loading, stale result, unhandled rejection, console/runtime error, unauthorized access, data leakage, atau kondisi di mana frontend dan backend menunjukkan state yang berbeda.

Audit juga security, data integrity, architecture, dan configuration. Pastikan nilai penting tidak dipercaya hanya karena berasal dari frontend; authorization, ownership, status, identifier, business rule, cost/price, dan privileged field harus diverifikasi pada authoritative layer yang tepat. Pastikan tidak ada secret, credential, token, private data, atau internal error sensitif yang terekspos. Periksa transaction safety, retry/idempotency, concurrency, duplicate protection, persistence consistency, serta failure semantics untuk operasi yang stateful, irreversible, destructive, atau berbayar. Pastikan shared logic/configuration benar-benar memiliki source of truth yang jelas dan tidak ada duplicated hardcode atau implementation paralel yang bisa menghasilkan behavior berbeda.

Untuk setiap bug, missing handling, configuration error, security issue, race condition, atau inconsistency yang masih berada dalam scope, lakukan **root-cause analysis lalu langsung perbaiki** menggunakan perubahan sekecil, seaman, dan sekonsisten mungkin dengan existing architecture. Jangan hanya menuliskan rekomendasi. Jangan menghilangkan validation/security supaya test lolos, jangan melemahkan assertion, jangan membuat fallback palsu, artificial delay, atau workaround yang menyembunyikan akar masalah. Setelah setiap fix, periksa caller dan dependent flow yang terdampak untuk memastikan tidak muncul regression baru. Masalah di luar scope cukup dicatat sebagai separate finding kecuali benar-benar menjadi blocker.

Setelah semua temuan diperbaiki, lakukan **QC kedua dari awal seolah-olah kamu reviewer baru**. Jalankan kembali test yang relevan, lint, type-check, build, unit/integration/e2e test, targeted regression test, dan validation script yang tersedia. Jika critical behavior belum memiliki coverage, tambahkan test yang proporsional terutama untuk bug yang ditemukan, failure path, retry, race condition, concurrency, dan edge case penting. Jangan menyatakan suatu behavior â€œverifiedâ€ jika hanya berdasarkan pembacaan code. Jelaskan secara transparan bagian yang benar-benar diuji secara runtime, bagian yang diverifikasi secara statis, serta bagian yang belum dapat diuji karena keterbatasan environment, credential, database, device, atau external service.

Terakhir, lakukan final diff review untuk memastikan tidak ada debug code, temporary flag, commented workaround, dead code, unused import, duplicated config, hardcoded value yang tidak semestinya, TODO kritis, naming/type mismatch, accidental logging, credential/secret, atau perubahan unrelated. Berikan laporan akhir yang dapat diaudit berisi: scope yang diperiksa, requirement dan flow yang diverifikasi, edge case yang diuji, bug/celah yang ditemukan beserta root cause, perubahan yang dilakukan, file penting yang disentuh, test/command yang benar-benar dijalankan beserta hasilnya, limitation atau residual risk, serta keputusan akhir **PASS / PASS WITH KNOWN LIMITATIONS / BLOCKED**. Jangan memberikan status PASS hanya karena code terlihat benar; PASS hanya diberikan jika implementasi sudah cukup terverifikasi sesuai kemampuan environment yang tersedia.

Ship the exact reviewed change through risk-specific gates. Optimize for confidence per minute: never omit a required gate, and never repeat a gate that cannot add material evidence.

## 0. Operate as one delivery entrypoint

### Preserve the local-development boundary

Ordinary requests to implement, build, fix, change, continue, test, or QA a
feature authorize local workspace work only. They may include local edits,
focused tests, a localhost runtime, an SSH tunnel, and operator visual QA. They
do not authorize a commit, push, Pull Request, CI dispatch, merge, landing,
deployment, or production access. Stop after the requested local result and
report the current state.

Authorization does not cascade beyond the action named by the operator:

- `QA`, `verify`, `review`, or `is this ready?` authorizes read-only assessment
  and requested checks only; it does not authorize Git or remote mutations.
- `commit` authorizes a scoped local commit only, not a push or PR.
- `push` authorizes the required scoped commit when needed and a non-force push
  of the task branch, not a PR.
- `open a PR` authorizes the required scoped commit, branch push, and PR, not a
  merge or deployment.
- `merge`, `land`, or `deliver` authorizes the scoped delivery workflow to its
  declared non-production target.
- `deploy`, `go live`, or an expl<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="5009" />
End every authorized delivery report with this receipt. Do not force this
receipt onto ordinary implementation or local-QA reports. The receipt is a
floor, not a ceiling: keep its fields and order fixed so the operator can scan

the receipt, never instead of it.

```markdown
## Delivery Receipt
- Verdict: ready to land | deployed and monitoring | not ready (<missing gate>) | blocked (<exact dependency>)

```

Rules for the receipt:

import { afterEach, test } from 'node:test'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'

const checker = resolve(
  dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)),
  'check-supabase-migration-lineage.sh'
)
const temporaryRepositories = []

afterEach(() => {
  for (const repository of temporaryRepositories.splice(0)) {
    rmSync(repository, { force: true, recursive: true })
  }
})

function git(repository, ...args) {
  return execFileSync('git', args, {
    cwd: repository,
    encoding: 'utf8',
    stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
  }).trim()
}

function createRepository() {
  const repository = mkdtempSync(
    resolve(tmpdir(), 'qreed-migration-lineage-test-')
  )
  temporaryRepositories.push(repository)
  git(repository, 'init', '--quiet')
  git(repository, 'config', 'user.email', 'migration-contract@qreed.invalid')
  git(repository, 'config', 'user.name', 'Migration Contract')
  mkdirSync(resolve(repository, 'supabase/migrations'), { recursive: true })
  writeFileSync(
    resolve(
      repository,
      'supabase/migrations/20260723170000_initial_contract.sql'
    ),
    'select 1;\n'
  )
  git(repository, 'add', '.')
  git(repository, 'commit', '--quiet', '-m', 'baseline')
  return {
    baseline: git(repository, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'),
    repository,
  }
}

function commitAll(repository, message) {
  git(repository, 'add', '--all')
  git(repository, 'commit', '--quiet', '-m', message)
}

function check(repository, baseline) {
  return spawnSync(checker, [baseline, 'HEAD'], {
    cwd: repository,
    encoding: 'utf8',
  })
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

if [[ $# -lt 1 || $# -gt 2 ]]; then
  echo "Usage: $0 <baseline-git-commit> [head-ref]" >&2
  exit 2
fi

baseline_git_commit="$1"
head_ref="${2:-HEAD}"

if [[ ! "$baseline_git_commit" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] \
  || ! git cat-file -e "${baseline_git_commit}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "Invalid or unavailable baseline Git commit: $baseline_git_commit" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if ! git cat-file -e "${head_ref}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "Invalid or unavailable head Git ref: $head_ref" >&2
  exit 1
fi

  git ls-tree -r --name-only "$baseline_git_commit" -- supabase/migrations | sort
)

for migration_file in "${baseline_migration_files[@]}"; do
  baseline_blob="$(git rev-parse "$baseline_git_commit:$migration_file")"
  if ! head_blob="$(git rev-parse "$head_ref:$migration_file" 2>/dev/null)"; then
    echo "Applied migration was deleted after the baseline: $migration_file" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  if [[ "$head_blob" != "$baseline_blob" ]]; then
    echo "Applied migration was modified after the baseline: $migration_file" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done

function canonicalizeJson(value: unknown): string {
  if (value === null) return 'null'
  if (typeof value === 'string') return JSON.stringify(value)
  if (typeof value === 'boolean') return value ? 'true' : 'false'

Tangani happy path sekaligus kondisi penting seperti invalid input, null/undefined, empty data, malformed payload, network/provider failure, timeout, duplicate action, double-submit, repeated request, partial failure, retry, refresh/reload, async operation, race condition, stale state, authorization failure, dan kondisi lain yang relevan terhadap fitur tersebut. Pastikan validation berada di layer yang tepat, backend tidak mempercayai data penting hanya karena dikirim frontend, permission/ownership diverifikasi secara authoritative, error handling tidak membocorkan informasi sensitif, serta operasi stateful/destructive/berbayar memiliki mekanisme yang aman terhadap retry atau duplicate execution jika diperlukan.

Gunakan dan pertahankan **single source of truth** untuk logic, configuration, model/data mapping, business rule, constants, pricing/cost, capability, atau settings yang memang seharusnya shared. Jangan membuat duplicate implementation hanya agar pekerjaan lebih cepat selesai jika logic yang sama sudah tersedia atau seharusnya diekstrak menjadi reusable/shared layer. Hindari hardcode yang seharusnya configurable, jangan membuat hidden dependency, workaround rapuh, fake fallback, artificial delay, atau logic yang hanya menyembunyikan akar masalah. Jangan melakukan refactor besar terhadap unrelated code dan jangan menambahkan fitur tambahan yang tidak diminta. Jika menemukan masalah di luar scope, catat saja kecuali masalah tersebut benar-benar menjadi blocker terhadap implementasi yang sedang dikerjakan.

Setelah implementasi selesai, lakukan verifikasi nyata terhadap seluruh bagian yang disentuh. Jalankan test yang tersedia dan relevan, lint, type-check, build, unit/integration/e2e test, targeted test, atau validation script lain yang memang digunakan repository. Periksa juga semua caller/dependency yang terdampak agar perubahan tidak menyebabkan regression. Pastikan tidak ada console/runtime error, unhandled rejection, dead code, unused import, duplicate config, debug statement, credential/secret, temporary workaround, atau perubahan file yang tidak diperlukan. Jangan menyatakan fitur sudah bekerja jika hanya berdasarkan code inspection; bedakan dengan jelas antara bagian yang benar-benar diuji secara runtime dan bagian yang hanya diverifikasi secara statis. Jika environment, credential, database, device, atau external service tertentu tidak tersedia, jangan mengarang hasil test dan jelaskan limitation tersebut secara eksplisit.

Sebelum menyelesaikan pekerjaan, lakukan satu final review terhadap seluruh diff dan requirement untuk memastikan tidak ada poin spec yang tertinggal, tidak ada implementasi yang keluar scope, tidak ada behavior existing yang rusak, serta seluruh konfigurasi dan dependency konsisten. Setelah semuanya selesai, berikan laporan yang spesifik berisi: apa yang diimplementasikan, keputusan desain penting, file utama yang berubah, edge case yang ditangani, test/command yang benar-benar dijalankan beserta hasilnya, limitation atau residual risk bila ada, dan bagian yang sengaja tidak dikerjakan karena berada di luar scope. Jika instruksi pekerjaan meminta commit/push, lakukan hanya setelah implementasi dan testing selesai, gunakan commit yang jelas, push ke branch kerja yang ditentukan, dan jangan merge atau deploy kecuali diminta secara eksplisit.

# Deliver QReed Change

Ship the exact reviewed change through risk-specific gates. Optimize for confidence per minute: never omit a required gate, and never repeat a gate that cannot add material evidence.

## 0. Operate as one delivery entrypoint

### Preserve the local-development boundary

Ordinary requests to implement, build, fix, change, continue, test, or QA a
feature authorize local workspace work only. They may include local edits,
focused tests, a localhost runtime, an SSH tunnel, and operator visual QA. They
do not authorize a commit, push, Pull Request, CI dispatch, merge, landing,
deployment, or production access. Stop after the requested local result and
report the current state.

Authorization does not cascade beyond the action named by the operator:

- `QA`, `verify`, `review`, or `is this ready?` authorizes read-only assessment
  and requested checks only; it does not authorize Git or remote mutations.
- `commit` authorizes a scoped local commit only, not a push or PR.
- `push` authorizes the required scoped commit when needed and a non-force push
  of the task branch, not a PR.
- `open a PR` authorizes the required scoped commit, branch push, and PR, not a
  merge or deployment.
- `merge`, `land`, or `deliver` authorizes the scoped delivery workflow to its
  declared non-production target.
- `deploy`, `go live`, or an expl<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="5009" />
End every authorized delivery report with this receipt. Do not force this
receipt onto ordinary implementation or local-QA reports. The receipt is a
floor, not a ceiling: keep its fields and order fixed so the operator can scan
it in seconds, and add extra judgment (context, corrections, warnings) outside
the receipt, never instead of it.

```markdown
## Delivery Receipt
- Verdict: ready to land | deployed and monitoring | not ready (<missing gate>) | blocked (<exact dependency>)
- Outcome: <1 sentence, user/business impact - what changes for users, not what the code does>
- Technical: <1-2 sentences: mechanism, invariants preserved> | SHA <sha> | PR <url>
- Gates: <one line per gate: name -> PASS/FAIL -> link to CI run / PR check / evidence>
- Skipped: <gate -> classifier reason> (or "none")
- Not proven automatically: <what the gates cannot cover - e.g. real-device Android behavior, visual judgment> (or "none")
- Manual check still needed from operator: <list, or "none">
- Radar: <task is DONE, but list what still stands from the surrounding arc -
  open follow-ups, pending flags/rollouts, uninvestigated warnings - and which
  one deserves attention first. "none" only if genuinely nothing stands.>
```

Rules for the receipt:

- `Outcome` and `Technical` are both mandatory: the operator scans `Outcome`
  first and only reads `Technical` to verify the mechanism matches intent.
- `Gates` lines are pass/fail plus a link; do not inline full commands or raw
  output (the link carries that).
- `Radar` is always present and always separate from the task verdict: a task
  can be DONE while the arc still has standing items. Never let radar items
  soften or blur the verdict, and never omit them because they are not urgent.
- `Manual check still needed` must be explicit so the operator never has to
  guess which smoke test remains theirs; device-specific and visual checks
  belong here when no automated gate covers them.

# Deliver QReed Change

Ship the exact reviewed change through risk-specific gates. Optimize for confidence per minute: never omit a required gate, and never repeat a gate that cannot add material evidence.

## 0. Operate as one delivery entrypoint

### Preserve the local-development boundary

Ordinary requests to implement, build, fix, change, continue, test, or QA a
feature authorize local workspace work only. They may include local edits,
focused tests, a localhost runtime, an SSH tunnel, and operator visual QA. They
do not authorize a commit, push, Pull Request, CI dispatch, merge, landing,
deployment, or production access. Stop after the requested local result and
report the current state.

Authorization does not cascade beyond the action named by the operator:

- `QA`, `verify`, `review`, or `is this ready?` authorizes read-only assessment
  and requested checks only; it does not authorize Git or remote mutations.
- `commit` authorizes a scoped local commit only, not a push or PR.
- `push` authorizes the required scoped commit when needed and a non-force push
  of the task branch, not a PR.
- `open a PR` authorizes the required scoped commit, branch push, and PR, not a
  merge or deployment.
- `merge`, `land`, or `deliver` authorizes the scoped delivery workflow to its
  declared non-production target.
- `deploy`, `go live`, or an expl<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="5009" />
End every authorized delivery report with this receipt. Do not force this
receipt onto ordinary implementation or local-QA reports. The receipt is a
floor, not a ceiling: keep its fields and order fixed so the operator can scan
it in seconds, and add extra judgment (context, corrections, warnings) outside
the receipt, never instead of it.

```markdown
## Delivery Receipt
- Verdict: ready to land | deployed and monitoring | not ready (<missing gate>) | blocked (<exact dependency>)
- Outcome: <1 sentence, user/business impact - what changes for users, not what the code does>
- Technical: <1-2 sentences: mechanism, invariants preserved> | SHA <sha> | PR <url>
- Gates: <one line per gate: name -> PASS/FAIL -> link to CI run / PR check / evidence>
- Skipped: <gate -> classifier reason> (or "none")
- Not proven automatically: <what the gates cannot cover - e.g. real-device Android behavior, visual judgment> (or "none")
- Manual check still needed from operator: <list, or "none">
- Radar: <task is DONE, but list what still stands from the surrounding arc -
  open follow-ups, pending flags/rollouts, uninvestigated warnings - and which
  one deserves attention first. "none" only if genuinely nothing stands.>
```

Rules for the receipt:

- `Outcome` and `Technical` are both mandatory: the operator scans `Outcome`
  first and only reads `Technical` to verify the mechanism matches intent.
- `Gates` lines are pass/fail plus a link; do not inline full commands or raw
  output (the link carries that).
- `Radar` is always present and always separate from the task verdict: a task
  can be DONE while the arc still has standing items. Never let radar items
  soften or blur the verdict, and never omit them because they are not urgent.
- `Manual check still needed` must be explicit so the operator never has to
  guess which smoke test remains theirs; device-specific and visual checks
  belong here when no automated gate covers them.

# 03 Ã¢â‚¬â€ Different surfaces, shared lifecycle

Parent: [senior architecture](2026-09-05-generation-unification.md).
Dependencies: shared catalog spec 00, admission/retry spec 01 and read/history spec 02.
Classification: core integration. Delivery is split into **stage 4 Canvas** and
**stage 5 Generate**, because their interaction and regression boundaries differ.

## Outcome and shared boundary

Canvas remains node/graph-driven. Generate remains form/card-driven. They share
typed job snapshots, immutable request identity, retry preparation and result
identity. Neither surface owns terminal status, provider dispatch or money.

Extract shared observation logic only where it removes duplicate semantics;
do not force one large hook/component to implement both products. Proposed
observation state is separate from job state: observing, reconnecting/session
unavailable, and idle. Progress/ETA remain presentation, not terminal authority.

Every async observer must validate subscription/attempt identity AFTER await,
not just before scheduling. Stop/start/unmount invalidates prior callbacks.
Out-of-order replies cannot regress the current observation. When no authoritative
revision exists, serialize reads per job and use a subscription epoch rather
than assuming client receipt time or `completed_at` establishes total ordering.
Allow the legitimate timeoutÃ¢â€ â€™completed late-attach transition.

# Deliver QReed Change

Ship the exact reviewed change through risk-specific gates. Optimize for confidence per minute: never omit a required gate, and never repeat a gate that cannot add material evidence.

## 0. Operate as one delivery entrypoint

### Preserve the local-development boundary

Ordinary requests to implement, build, fix, change, continue, test, or QA a
feature authorize local workspace work only. They may include local edits,
focused tests, a localhost runtime, an SSH tunnel, and operator visual QA. They
do not authorize a commit, push, Pull Request, CI dispatch, merge, landing,
deployment, or production access. Stop after the requested local result and
report the current state.

Authorization does not cascade beyond the action named by the operator:

- `QA`, `verify`, `review`, or `is this ready?` authorizes read-only assessment
  and requested checks only; it does not authorize Git or remote mutations.
- `commit` authorizes a scoped local commit only, not a push or PR.
- `push` authorizes the required scoped commit when needed and a non-force push
  of the task branch, not a PR.
- `open a PR` authorizes the required scoped commit, branch push, and PR, not a
  merge or deployment.
- `merge`, `land`, or `deliver` authorizes the scoped delivery workflow to its
  declared non-production target.
- `deploy`, `go live`, or an expl<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="5009" />
End every authorized delivery report with this receipt. Do not force this
receipt onto ordinary implementation or local-QA reports. The receipt is a
floor, not a ceiling: keep its fields and order fixed so the operator can scan
it in seconds, and add extra judgment (context, corrections, warnings) outside
the receipt, never instead of it.

```markdown
## Delivery Receipt
- Verdict: ready to land | deployed and monitoring | not ready (<missing gate>) | blocked (<exact dependency>)
- Outcome: <1 sentence, user/business impact - what changes for users, not what the code does>
- Technical: <1-2 sentences: mechanism, invariants preserved> | SHA <sha> | PR <url>
- Gates: <one line per gate: name -> PASS/FAIL -> link to CI run / PR check / evidence>
- Skipped: <gate -> classifier reason> (or "none")
- Not proven automatically: <what the gates cannot cover - e.g. real-device Android behavior, visual judgment> (or "none")
- Manual check still needed from operator: <list, or "none">
- Radar: <task is DONE, but list what still stands from the surrounding arc -
  open follow-ups, pending flags/rollouts, uninvestigated warnings - and which
  one deserves attention first. "none" only if genuinely nothing stands.>
```

Rules for the receipt:

- `Outcome` and `Technical` are both mandatory: the operator scans `Outcome`
  first and only reads `Technical` to verify the mechanism matches intent.
- `Gates` lines are pass/fail plus a link; do not inline full commands or raw
  output (the link carries that).
- `Radar` is always present and always separate from the task verdict: a task
  can be DONE while the arc still has standing items. Never let radar items
  soften or blur the verdict, and never omit them because they are not urgent.
- `Manual check still needed` must be explicit so the operator never has to
  guess which smoke test remains theirs; device-specific and visual checks
  belong here when no automated gate covers them.

# 03 Ã¢â‚¬â€ Different surfaces, shared lifecycle

Parent: [senior architecture](2026-09-05-generation-unification.md).
Dependencies: shared catalog spec 00, admission/retry spec 01 and read/history spec 02.
Classification: core integration. Delivery is split into **stage 4 Canvas** and

## Outcome and shared boundary

Canvas remains node/graph-driven. Generate remains form/card-driven. They share
typed job snapshots, immutable request identity, retry preparation and result
identity. Neither surface owns terminal status, provider dispatch or money.

Extract shared observation logic only where it removes duplicate semantics;
do not force one large hook/component to implement both products. Proposed
observation state is separate from job state: observing, reconnecting/session

than assuming client receipt time or `completed_at` establishes total ordering.

# 03 Ã¢â‚¬â€ Different surfaces, shared lifecycle

Parent: [senior architecture](2026-09-05-generation-unification.md).
Dependencies: shared catalog spec 00, admission/retry spec 01 and read/history spec 02.
Classification: core integration. Delivery is split into **stage 4 Canvas** and
**stage 5 Generate**, because their interaction and regression boundaries differ.

## Outcome and shared boundary

Canvas remains node/graph-driven. Generate remains form/card-driven. They share
typed job snapshots, immutable request identity, retry preparation and result
identity. Neither surface owns terminal status, provider dispatch or money.

Extract shared observation logic only where it removes duplicate semantics;
do not force one large hook/component to implement both products. Proposed
observation state is separate from job state: observing, reconnecting/session
unavailable, and idle. Progress/ETA remain presentation, not terminal authority.

Every async observer must validate subscription/attempt identity AFTER await,
not just before scheduling. Stop/start/unmount invalidates prior callbacks.
Out-of-order replies cannot regress the current observation. When no authoritative
revision exists, serialize reads per job and use a subscription epoch rather
than assuming client receipt time or `completed_at` establishes total ordering.
Allow the legitimate timeoutÃ¢â€ â€™completed late-attach transition.

## Stage 4 Ã¢â‚¬â€ Canvas binding and conditional application

### Shared catalog and request adapter

All public image/video generator consumers derive product/model choices, defaults,
controls and validation from spec 00. Specialized node presentations may remain,
but cannot keep separate business-rule lists. Resolve graph inputs into canonical
ordered references/settings, then c<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="2761" />known`,
  never a fabricated refund.

## Shared origin and visibility corrections

- Explicit `result_metadata.generation_origin` wins. Legacy `create:` proves
  Generate, legacy Canvas context proves Canvas, and all other old rows are
  labelled `legacy` rather than being silently reclassified as Canvas.
- The same resolver builds Recent/Activity SQL filters and public mapping.
  Generate activity gets `/generate?generation=<id>` rather than a fabricated
  Canvas destination; hidden rows stay absent.
- Generation activity no longer uses a creation-age cutoff as recovery
  eligibility. Instant Try's separate 14-day presentation behavior is
  unchanged.
- Dismiss now verifies a returned row, so a zero-row race cannot be reported as
  a successful local disappearance.

## Deferred to Stage 4Ã¢â‚¬â€œ5

- Canvas node binding/late-result application and Generate card integration
  must consume this boundary in their dedicated stages. The existing direct
  Generate 10-minute compatibility reader is not treated as the new recovery
  authority.
- The deferred versioned late-result visibility policy is deliberately not
  enabled here; existing `hidden_at` semantics remain intact.

# 03 Ã¢â‚¬â€ Different surfaces, shared lifecycle

Parent: [senior architecture](2026-09-05-generation-unification.md).
Dependencies: shared catalog spec 00, admission/retry spec 01 and read/history spec 02.
Classification: core integration. Delivery is split into **stage 4 Canvas** and
**stage 5 Generate**, because their interaction and regression boundaries differ.

## Outcome and shared boundary

Canvas remains node/graph-driven. Generate remains form/card-driven. They share
typed job snapshots, immutable request identity, retry preparation and result
identity. Neither surface owns terminal status, provider dispatch or money.

Extract shared observation logic only where it removes duplicate semantics;
do not force one large hook/component to implement both products. Proposed
observation state is separate from job state: observing, reconnecting/session
unavailable, and idle. Progress/ETA remain presentation, not terminal authority.

Every async observer must validate subscription/attempt identity AFTER await,
not just before scheduling. Stop/start/unmount invalidates prior callbacks.
Out-of-order replies cannot regress the current observation. When no authoritative
revision exists, serialize reads per job and use a subscription epoch rather
than assuming client receipt time or `completed_at` establishes total ordering.
Allow the legitimate timeoutÃ¢â€ â€™completed late-attach transition.

ordered references/settings, then c<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="2761" />known`,
  never a fabricated refund.

## Shared origin and visibility corrections

- Explicit `result_metadata.generation_origin` wins. Legacy `create:` proves

# 03 Ã¢â‚¬â€ Different surfaces, shared lifecycle

Parent: [senior architecture](2026-09-05-generation-unification.md).
Dependencies: shared catalog spec 00, admission/retry spec 01 and read/history spec 02.
Classification: core integration. Delivery is split into **stage 4 Canvas** and
**stage 5 Generate**, because their interaction and regression boundaries differ.

## Outcome and shared boundary

Canvas remains node/graph-driven. Generate remains form/card-driven. They share
typed job snapshots, immutable request identity, retry preparation and result
identity. Neither surface owns terminal status, provider dispatch or money.

Extract shared observation logic only where it removes duplicate semantics;
do not force one large hook/component to implement both products. Proposed
observation state is separate from job state: observing, reconnecting/session
unavailable, and idle. Progress/ETA remain presentation, not terminal authority.

Every async observer must validate subscription/attempt identity AFTER await,
not just before scheduling. Stop/start/unmount invalidates prior callbacks.
Out-of-order replies cannot regress the current observation. When no authoritative
revision exists, serialize reads per job and use a subscription epoch rather
than assuming client receipt time or `completed_at` establishes total ordering.
Allow the legitimate timeoutÃ¢â€ â€™completed late-attach transition.

## Stage 4 Ã¢â‚¬â€ Canvas binding and conditional application

### Shared catalog and request adapter

All public image/video generator consumers derive product/model choices, defaults,
controls and validation from spec 00. Specialized node presentations may remain,
but cannot keep separate business-rule lists. Resolve graph inputs into canonical
ordered references/settings, then c<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="2761" />known`,
  never a fabricated refund.

## Shared origin and visibility corrections

- Explicit `result_metadata.generation_origin` wins. Legacy `create:` proves
  Generate, legacy Canvas context proves Canvas, and all other old rows are
  labelled `legacy` rather than being silently reclassified as Canvas.
- The same resolver builds Recent/Activity SQL filters and public mapping.
  Generate activity gets `/generate?generation=<id>` rather than a fabricated
  Canvas destination; hidden rows stay absent.
- Generation activity no longer uses a creation-age cutoff as recovery
  eligibility. Instant Try's separate 14-day presentation behavior is
  unchanged.
- Dismiss now verifies a returned row, so a zero-row race cannot be reported as
  a successful local disappearance.

- Canvas node binding/late-result application and Generate card integration
  must consume this boundary in their dedicated stages. The existing direct
  Generate 10-minute compatibility reader is not treated as the new recovery
  authority.
- The deferred versioned late-result visibility policy is deliberately not
  enabled here; existing `hidden_at` semantics remain intact.

## Outcome and shared boundary

Canvas remains node/graph-driven. Generate remains form/card-driven. They share
typed job snapshots, immutable request identity, retry preparation and result
identity. Neither surface owns terminal status, provider dispatch or money.

do not force one large hook/component to implement both products. Proposed
observation state is separate from job state: observing, reconnecting/session

not just before scheduling. Stop/start/unmount invalidates prior callbacks.

Pastikan validation berada di layer yang tepat, backend tidak mempercayai data penting hanya karena dikirim frontend, permission/ownership diverifikasi secara authoritative, error handling tidak membocorkan informasi sensitif, serta operasi stateful/destructive/berbayar memiliki mekanisme yang aman terhadap retry atau duplicate execution jika diperlukan.

Gunakan dan pertahankan **single source of truth** untuk logic, configuration, model/data mapping, business rule, constants, pricing/cost, capability, atau settings yang memang seharusnya shared. Jangan membuat duplicate implementation hanya agar pekerjaan lebih cepat selesai jika logic yang sama sudah tersedia atau seharusnya diekstrak menjadi reusable/shared layer. Hindari hardcode yang seharusnya configurable, jangan membuat hidden dependency, workaround rapuh, fake fallback, artificial delay, atau logic yang hanya menyembunyikan akar masalah. Jangan melakukan refactor besar terhadap unrelated code dan jangan menambahkan fitur tambahan yang tidak diminta. Jika menemukan masalah di luar scope, catat saja kecuali masalah tersebut benar-benar menjadi blocker terhadap implementasi yang sedang dikerjakan.

Setelah implementasi selesai, lakukan verifikasi nyata terhadap seluruh bagian yang disentuh. Jalankan test yang tersedia dan relevan, lint, type-check, build, unit/integration/e2e test, targeted test, atau validation script lain yang memang digunakan repository. Periksa juga semua caller/dependency yang terdampak agar perubahan tidak menyebabkan regression. Pastikan tidak ada console/runtime error, unhandled rejection, dead code, unused import, duplicate config, debug statement, credential/secret, temporary workaround, atau perubahan file yang tidak diperlukan. Jangan menyatakan fitur sudah bekerja jika hanya berdasarkan code inspection; bedakan dengan jelas antara bagian yang benar-benar diuji secara runtime dan bagian yang hanya diverifikasi secara statis. Jika environment, credential, database, device, atau external service tertentu tidak tersedia, jangan mengarang hasil test dan jelaskan limitation tersebut secara eksplisit.

Sebelum menyelesaikan pekerjaan, lakukan satu final review terhadap seluruh diff dan requirement untuk memastikan tidak ada poin spec yang tertinggal, tidak ada implementasi yang keluar scope, tidak ada behavior existing yang rusak, serta seluruh konfigurasi dan dependency konsisten. Setelah semuanya selesai, berikan laporan yang spesifik berisi: apa yang diimplementasikan, keputusan desain penting, file utama yang berubah, edge case yang ditangani, test/command yang benar-benar dijalankan beserta hasilnya, limitation atau residual risk bila ada, dan bagian yang sengaja tidak dikerjakan karena berada di luar scope. Jika instruksi pekerjaan meminta commit/push, lakukan hanya setelah implementasi dan testing selesai, gunakan commit yang jelas, push ke branch kerja yang ditentukan, dan jangan merge atau deploy kecuali diminta secara eksplisit.

Pastikan validation berada di layer yang tepat, backend tidak mempercayai data penting hanya karena dikirim frontend, permission/ownership diverifikasi secara authoritative, error handling tidak membocorkan informasi sensitif, serta operasi stateful/destructive/berbayar memiliki mekanisme yang aman terhadap retry atau duplicate execution jika diperlukan.

Gunakan dan pertahankan **single source of truth** untuk logic, configuration, model/data mapping, business rule, constants, pricing/cost, capability, atau settings yang memang seharusnya shared. Jangan membuat duplicate implementation hanya agar pekerjaan lebih cepat selesai jika logic yang sama sudah tersedia atau seharusnya diekstrak menjadi reusable/shared layer. Hindari hardcode yang seharusnya configurable, jangan membuat hidden dependency, workaround rapuh, fake fallback, artificial delay, atau logic yang hanya menyembunyikan akar masalah. Jangan melakukan refactor besar terhadap unrelated code dan jangan menambahkan fitur tambahan yang tidak diminta. Jika menemukan masalah di luar scope, catat saja kecuali masalah tersebut benar-benar menjadi blocker terhadap implementasi yang sedang dikerjakan.

Setelah implementasi selesai, lakukan verifikasi nyata terhadap seluruh bagian yang disentuh. Jalankan test yang tersedia dan relevan, lint, type-check, build, unit/integration/e2e test, targeted test, atau validation script lain yang memang digunakan repository. Periksa juga semua caller/dependency yang terdampak agar perubahan tidak menyebabkan regression. Pastikan tidak ada console/runtime error, unhandled rejection, dead code, unused import, duplicate config, debug statement, credential/secret, temporary workaround, atau perubahan file yang tidak diperlukan. Jangan menyatakan fitur sudah bekerja jika hanya berdasarkan code inspection; bedakan dengan jelas antara bagian yang benar-benar diuji secara runtime dan bagian yang hanya diverifikasi secara statis. Jika environment, credential, database, device, atau external service tertentu tidak tersedia, jangan mengarang hasil test dan jelaskan limitation tersebut secara eksplisit.

Sebelum menyelesaikan pekerjaan, lakukan satu final review terhadap seluruh diff dan requirement untuk memastikan tidak ada poin spec yang tertinggal, tidak ada implementasi yang keluar scope, tidak ada behavior existing yang rusak, serta seluruh konfigurasi dan dependency konsisten. Setelah semuanya selesai, berikan laporan yang spesifik berisi: apa yang diimplementasikan, keputusan desain penting, file utama yang berubah, edge case yang ditangani, test/command yang benar-benar dijalankan beserta hasilnya, limitation atau residual risk bila ada, dan bagian yang sengaja tidak dikerjakan karena berada di luar scope. Jika instruksi pekerjaan meminta commit/push, lakukan hanya setelah implementasi dan testing selesai, gunakan commit yang jelas, push ke branch kerja yang ditentukan, dan jangan merge atau deploy kecuali diminta secara eksplisit.

Tangani happy path sekaligus kondisi penting seperti invalid input, null/undefined, empty data, malformed payload, network/provider failure, timeout, duplicate action, double-submit, repeated request, partial failure, retry, refresh/reload, async operation, race condition, stale state, authorization failure, dan kondisi lain yang relevan terhadap fitur tersebut. Pastikan validation berada di layer yang tepat, backend tidak mempercayai data penting hanya karena dikirim frontend, permission/ownership diverifikasi secara authoritative, error handling tidak membocorkan informasi sensitif, serta operasi stateful/destructive/berbayar memiliki mekanisme yang aman terhadap retry atau duplicate execution jika diperlukan.

Gunakan dan pertahankan **single source of truth** untuk logic, configuration, model/data mapping, business rule, constants, pricing/cost, capability, atau settings yang memang seharusnya shared. Jangan membuat duplicate implementation hanya agar pekerjaan lebih cepat selesai jika logic yang sama sudah tersedia atau seharusnya diekstrak menjadi reusable/shared layer. Hindari hardcode yang seharusnya configurable, jangan membuat hidden dependency, workaround rapuh, fake fallback, artificial delay, atau logic yang hanya menyembunyikan akar masalah. Jangan melakukan refactor besar terhadap unrelated code dan jangan menambahkan fitur tambahan yang tidak diminta. Jika menemukan masalah di luar scope, catat saja kecuali masalah tersebut benar-benar menjadi blocker terhadap implementasi yang sedang dikerjakan.

Setelah implementasi selesai, lakukan verifikasi nyata terhadap seluruh bagian yang disentuh. Jalankan test yang tersedia dan relevan, lint, type-check, build, unit/integration/e2e test, targeted test, atau validation script lain yang memang digunakan repository. Periksa juga semua caller/dependency yang terdampak agar perubahan tidak menyebabkan regression. Pastikan tidak ada console/runtime error, unhandled rejection, dead code, unused import, duplicate config, debug statement, credential/secret, temporary workaround, atau perubahan file yang tidak diperlukan. Jangan menyatakan fitur sudah bekerja jika hanya berdasarkan code inspection; bedakan dengan jelas antara bagian yang benar-benar diuji secara runtime dan bagian yang hanya diverifikasi secara statis. Jika environment, credential, database, device, atau external service tertentu tidak tersedia, jangan mengarang hasil test dan jelaskan limitation tersebut secara eksplisit.

Sebelum menyelesaikan pekerjaan, lakukan satu final review terhadap seluruh diff dan requirement untuk memastikan tidak ada poin spec yang tertinggal, tidak ada implementasi yang keluar scope, tidak ada behavior existing yang rusak, serta seluruh konfigurasi dan dependency konsisten. Setelah semuanya selesai, berikan laporan yang spesifik berisi: apa yang diimplementasikan, keputusan desain penting, file utama yang berubah, edge case yang ditangani, test/command yang benar-benar dijalankan beserta hasilnya, limitation atau residual risk bila ada, dan bagian yang sengaja tidak dikerjakan karena berada di luar scope. Jika instruksi pekerjaan meminta commit/push, lakukan hanya setelah implementasi dan testing selesai, gunakan commit yang jelas, push ke branch kerja yang ditentukan, dan jangan merge atau deploy kecuali diminta secara eksplisit.

Cocokkan actual code dengan intended behavior dan pola arsitektur existing. Jangan berasumsi code benar hanya karena compile, build, atau terlihat masuk akal; telusuri actual execution flow dari input/user action sampai hasil akhir dan pastikan tidak ada logic yang salah, duplikasi source of truth, konfigurasi yang bertentangan, dead code, insecure handling, coupling yang tidak perlu, behavior di luar requirement, atau implementasi yang diam-diam berbeda dari spec.

Jangan melakukan refactor besar yang tidak diperlukan, jangan membuat duplicate implementation baru jika reusable pattern sudah tersedia, jangan menambahkan fallback palsu untuk menyembunyikan error sebenarnya, dan jangan memperluas scope hanya karena menemukan unrelated issue. Jika menemukan masalah di luar scope, catat sebagai finding terpisah tanpa ikut mengubahnya kecuali benar-benar menjadi blocker untuk fitur yang sedang di-QC. Setelah setiap fix, periksa seluruh caller/dependency yang terdampak agar perubahan tersebut tidak menciptakan regression baru.

Setelah seluruh temuan diperbaiki, lakukan **QC kedua dari awal seolah-olah kamu reviewer baru**. Jalankan semua validasi yang memang tersedia dan relevan di repository: unit/integration/e2e test, lint, type-check, build, targeted test, atau script validation lain yang aman dijalankan. # 03 Ã¢â‚¬â€ Different surfaces, shared lifecycle

Parent: [senior architecture](2026-09-05-generation-unification.md).
Dependencies: shared catalog spec 00, admission/retry spec 01 and read/history spec 02.
Classification: core integration. Delivery is split into **stage 4 Canvas** and
**stage 5 Generate**, because their interaction and regression boundaries differ.

## Outcome and shared boundary

Canvas remains node/graph-driven. Generate remains form/card-driven. They share
typed job snapshots, immutable request identity, retry preparation and result

# Deliver QReed Change

## 0. Operate as one delivery entrypoint

### Preserve the local-development boundary

Ordinary requests to implement, build, fix, change, continue, test, or QA a

- `open a PR` authorizes the required scoped commit, branch push, and PR, not a

```markdown
## Delivery Receipt
```

Rules for the receipt:

- `Outcome` and `Technical` are both mandatory: the operator scans `Outcome`

Ship the exact reviewed change through risk-specific gates. Optimize for confidence per minute: never omit a required gate, and never repeat a gate that cannot add material evidence.

## 0. Operate as one delivery entrypoint

### Preserve the local-development boundary

Ordinary requests to implement, build, fix, change, continue, test, or QA a
feature authorize local workspace work only. They may include local edits,

deployment, or production access. Stop after the requested local result and
report the current state.

  and requested checks only; it does not authorize Git or remote mutations.

- `push` authorizes the required scoped commit when needed and a non-force push
  of the task branch, not a PR.
- `open a PR` authorizes the required scoped commit, branch push, and PR, not a
  merge or deployment.
- `merge`, `land`, or `deliver` authorizes the scoped delivery workflow to its
  declared non-production target.
- `deploy`, `go live`, or an expl<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="5009" />

```markdown
## Delivery Receipt
```

# Deliver QReed Change

Ship the exact reviewed change through risk-specific gates. Optimize for confidence per minute: never omit a required gate, and never repeat a gate that cannot add material evidence.

## 0. Operate as one delivery entrypoint

### Preserve the local-development boundary

Ordinary requests to implement, build, fix, change, continue, test, or QA a
feature authorize local workspace work only. They may include local edits,
focused tests, a localhost runtime, an SSH tunnel, and operator visual QA. They
do not authorize a commit, push, Pull Request, CI dispatch, merge, landing,
deployment, or production access. Stop after the requested local result and
report the current state.

Authorization does not cascade beyond the action named by the operator:

- `QA`, `verify`, `review`, or `is this ready?` authorizes read-only assessment
  and requested checks only; it does not authorize Git or remote mutations.
- `commit` authorizes a scoped local commit only, not a push or PR.
- `push` authorizes the required scoped commit when needed and a non-force push
  of the task branch, not a PR.
- `open a PR` authorizes the required scoped commit, branch push, and PR, not a
  merge or deployment.
- `merge`, `land`, or `deliver` authorizes the scoped delivery workflow to its
  declared non-production target.
- `deploy`, `go live`, or an expl<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="5009" />
End every authorized delivery report with this receipt. Do not force this
receipt onto ordinary implementation or local-QA reports. The receipt is a
floor, not a ceiling: keep its fields and order fixed so the operator can scan
it in seconds, and add extra judgment (context, corrections, warnings) outside
the receipt, never instead of it.

```markdown
## Delivery Receipt
- Verdict: ready to land | deployed and monitoring | not ready (<missing gate>) | blocked (<exact dependency>)
- Outcome: <1 sentence, user/business impact - what changes for users, not what the code does>
- Technical: <1-2 sentences: mechanism, invariants preserved> | SHA <sha> | PR <url>
- Gates: <one line per gate: name -> PASS/FAIL -> link to CI run / PR check / evidence>
- Skipped: <gate -> classifier reason> (or "none")
- Not proven automatically: <what the gates cannot cover - e.g. real-device Android behavior, visual judgment> (or "none")
- Manual check still needed from operator: <list, or "none">
- Radar: <task is DONE, but list what still stands from the surrounding arc -
  open follow-ups, pending flags/rollouts, uninvestigated warnings - and which
  one deserves attention first. "none" only if genuinely nothing stands.>
```

Rules for the receipt:

- `Outcome` and `Technical` are both mandatory: the operator scans `Outcome`
  first and only reads `Technical` to verify the mechanism matches intent.
- `Gates` lines are pass/fail plus a link; do not inline full commands or raw
  output (the link carries that).
- `Radar` is always present and always separate from the task verdict: a task
  can be DONE while the arc still has standing items. Never let radar items
  soften or blur the verdict, and never omit them because they are not urgent.
- `Manual check still needed` must be explicit so the operator never has to
  guess which smoke test remains theirs; device-specific and visual checks
  belong here when no automated gate covers them.

Jangan melakukan refactor besar yang tidak diperlukan, jangan membuat duplicate implementation baru jika reusable pattern sudah tersedia, jangan menambahkan fallback palsu untuk menyembunyikan error sebenarnya, dan jangan memperluas scope hanya karena menemukan unrelated issue. Jika menemukan masalah di luar scope, catat sebagai finding terpisah tanpa ikut mengubahnya kecuali benar-benar menjadi blocker untuk fitur yang sedang di-QC. Setelah setiap fix, periksa seluruh caller/dependency yang terdampak agar perubahan tersebut tidak menciptakan regression baru.

Setelah seluruh temuan diperbaiki, lakukan **QC kedua dari awal seolah-olah kamu reviewer baru**. Jalankan semua validasi yang memang tersedia dan relevan di repository: unit/integration/e2e test, lint, type-check, build, targeted test, atau script validation lain yang aman dijalankan. Tambahkan atau perbaiki test jika terdapat critical behavior yang belum ter-cover, terutama untuk bug yang baru ditemukan, edge case penting, race condition, retry/idempotency, dan failure path. Jangan menyatakan suatu flow â€œverifiedâ€ jika hanya dibaca secara statis; bedakan dengan jelas antara static verification dan runtime verification. Jika ada bagian yang tidak dapat diuji karena membutuhkan credential, external service, environment, database, device, atau dependency tertentu, jangan mengarang hasilâ€”jelaskan apa yang belum bisa diuji, alasannya, risikonya, dan langkah verifikasi yang diperlukan.

Terakhir, lakukan final diff review dan pastikan tidak ada debug code, temporary flag, commented workaround, unused import, duplicate config, hardcoded value yang seharusnya shared/configurable, TODO kritis, inconsistent naming/type, secret, accidental logging, atau perubahan file yang tidak berkaitan. Hasil akhir harus berupa laporan yang spesifik dan dapat diaudit: scope yang diverifikasi, flow dan edge case yang diuji, temuan beserta root cause, perubahan yang dilakukan, file penting yang disentuh, command/test yang benar-benar dijalankan beserta hasilnya, limitation/residual risk, dan keputusan akhir **PASS / PASS WITH KNOWN LIMITATIONS / BLOCKED**. Jangan memberi status PASS hanya karena tidak menemukan error saat membaca code; PASS hanya jika implementasi sudah benar-benar cukup terverifikasi sesuai capability environment yang tersedia.

Periksa happy path, invalid input, null/undefined, empty data, malformed payload/response, missing/invalid ID, unsupported value, timeout, network failure, partial failure, repeated action, double-click/double-submit, duplicate request, refresh/reload, navigation away, browser back/forward, stale state, race condition, async completion yang datang tidak berurutan, component unmount, retry, recovery, caching, pagination/limit, persistence, dan kondisi ketika satu bagian berhasil tetapi bagian berikutnya gagal. Pastikan tidak ada duplicate data, duplicate transaction, false success, silent failure, infinite loading, stale result, inconsistent state, orphan record, data loss, unhandled rejection, console/runtime error, unauthorized access, data leakage, atau kondisi di mana UI dan backend menunjukkan state yang berbeda. Periksa juga seluruh button, form, input, modal, dropdown, navigation, API request, loading/error/success/empty state, responsive behavior, access control, direct URL access, dan seluruh config/environment yang digunakan oleh scope tersebut.

Audit security dan data integrity secara khusus. Jangan mempercayai nilai penting hanya karena dikirim frontend; ownership, authorization, status, price/cost, privileged field, identifier, dan business rule penting harus diverifikasi di server/layer authoritative yang tepat. Pastikan tidak ada secret, credential, token, sensitive internal error, atau private data yang terekspos ke client atau log. Periksa juga idempotency, transaction boundary, failure semantics, retry behavior, concurrent request, dan consistency antara database/backend/frontend bila relevan. Jika ada operasi berbayar, irreversible, destructive, atau stateful, pastikan retry maupun transport failure tidak secara tidak sengaja menggandakan efeknya. Jangan menghapus validation/security atau melemahkan test hanya supaya fitur terlihat bekerja.

Untuk setiap bug, celah, missing handling, atau konfigurasi salah yang masih berada dalam scope, lakukan **root-cause analysis lalu langsung perbaiki** dengan perubahan sekecil, seaman, dan sekonsisten mungkin terhadap existing codebase. Jangan melakukan refactor besar yang tidak diperlukan, jangan membuat duplicate implementation baru jika reusable pattern sudah tersedia, jangan menambahkan fallback palsu untuk menyembunyikan error sebenarnya, dan jangan memperluas scope hanya karena menemukan unrelated issue. Jika menemukan masalah di luar scope, catat sebagai finding terpisah tanpa ikut mengubahnya kecuali benar-benar menjadi blocker untuk fitur yang sedang di-QC. Setelah setiap fix, periksa seluruh caller/dependency yang terdampak agar perubahan tersebut tidak menciptakan regression baru.

Setelah seluruh temuan diperbaiki, lakukan **QC kedua dari awal seolah-olah kamu reviewer baru**. Jalankan semua validasi yang memang tersedia dan relevan di repository: unit/integration/e2e test, lint, type-check, build, targeted test, atau script validation lain yang aman dijalankan. Tambahkan atau perbaiki test jika terdapat critical behavior yang belum ter-cover, terutama untuk bug yang baru ditemukan, edge case penting, race condition, retry/idempotency, dan failure path. Jangan menyatakan suatu flow â€œverifiedâ€ jika hanya dibaca secara statis; bedakan dengan jelas antara static verification dan runtime verification. Jika ada bagian yang tidak dapat diuji karena membutuhkan credential, external service, environment, database, device, atau dependency tertentu, jangan mengarang hasilâ€”jelaskan apa yang belum bisa diuji, alasannya, risikonya, dan langkah verifikasi yang diperlukan.

Terakhir, lakukan final diff review dan pastikan tidak ada debug code, temporary flag, commented workaround, unused import, duplicate config, hardcoded value yang seharusnya shared/configurable, TODO kritis, inconsistent naming/type, secret, accidental logging, atau perubahan file yang tidak berkaitan. Hasil akhir harus berupa laporan yang spesifik dan dapat diaudit: scope yang diverifikasi, flow dan edge case yang diuji, temuan beserta root cause, perubahan yang dilakukan, file penting yang disentuh, command/test yang benar-benar dijalankan beserta hasilnya, limitation/residual risk, dan keputusan akhir **PASS / PASS WITH KNOWN LIMITATIONS / BLOCKED**. Jangan memberi status PASS hanya karena tidak menemukan error saat membaca code; PASS hanya jika implementasi sudah benar-benar cukup terverifikasi sesuai capability environment yang tersedia.

[20] user: Lakukan **audit, debugging, testing, dan Quality Control (QC) secara menyeluruh terhadap implementasi yang sudah dikerjakan pada scope/tahap saat ini**. Anggap fitur utamanya sudah selesai diimplementasikan, jadi fokus sekarang adalah memastikan seluruh hasil implementasi benar-benar benar, aman, stabil, sesuai requirement, tidak melebar dari scope, dan tidak menimbulkan regression. Sebelum mengubah code, baca kembali requirement/spec/dokumentasi yang relevan dan telusuri seluruh implementasi aktual di repository: file, route, API, service, controller, model, component, state, utility, config, dependency, permission, validation, persistence, asynchronous flow, dan integration point yang berkaitan dengan scope tersebut. Cocokkan actual code dengan intended behavior dan pola arsitektur existing. Jangan berasumsi code benar hanya karena compile, build, atau terlihat masuk akal; telusuri actual execution flow dari input/user action sampai hasil akhir dan pastikan tidak ada logic yang salah, duplikasi source of truth, konfigurasi yang bertentangan, dead code, insecure handling, coupling yang tidak perlu, behavior di luar requirement, atau implementasi yang diam-diam berbeda dari spec.

Lakukan QC secara aktif dengan mindset mencari kegagalan, bukan sekadar mencari alasan untuk PASS. Periksa happy path, invalid input, null/undefined, empty data, malformed payload/response, missing/invalid ID, unsupported value, timeout, network failure, partial failure, repeated action, double-click/double-submit, duplicate request, refresh/reload, navigation away, browser back/forward, stale state, race condition, async completion yang datang tidak berurutan, component unmount, retry, recovery, caching, pagination/limit, persistence, dan kondisi ketika satu bagian berhasil tetapi bagian berikutnya gagal. Pastikan tidak ada duplicate data, duplicate transaction, false success, silent failure, infinite loading, stale result, inconsistent state, orphan record, data loss, unhandled rejection, console/runtime error, unauthorized access, data leakage, atau kondisi di mana UI dan backend menunjukkan state yang berbeda. Periksa juga seluruh button, form, input, modal, dropdown, navigation, API request, loading/error/success/empty state, responsive behavior, access control, direct URL access, dan seluruh config/environment yang digunakan oleh scope tersebut.

Audit security dan data integrity secara khusus. Jangan mempercayai nilai penting hanya karena dikirim frontend; ownership, authorization, status, price/cost, privileged field, identifier, dan business rule penting harus diverifikasi di server/layer authoritative yang tepat. Pastikan tidak ada secret, credential, token, sensitive internal error, atau private data yang terekspos ke client atau log. Periksa juga idempotency, transaction boundary, failure semantics, retry behavior, concurrent request, dan consistency antara database/backend/frontend bila relevan. Jika ada operasi berbayar, irreversible, destructive, atau stateful, pastikan retry maupun transport failure tidak secara tidak sengaja menggandakan efeknya. Jangan menghapus validation/security atau melemahkan test hanya supaya fitur terlihat bekerja.

Untuk setiap bug, celah, missing handling, atau konfigurasi salah yang masih berada dalam scope, lakukan **root-cause analysis lalu langsung perbaiki** dengan perubahan sekecil, seaman, dan sekonsisten mungkin terhadap existing codebase. Jangan melakukan refactor besar yang tidak diperlukan, jangan membuat duplicate implementation baru jika reusable pattern sudah tersedia, jangan menambahkan fallback palsu untuk menyembunyikan error sebenarnya, dan jangan memperluas scope hanya karena menemukan unrelated issue. Jika menemukan masalah di luar scope, catat sebagai finding terpisah tanpa ikut mengubahnya kecuali benar-benar menjadi blocker untuk fitur yang sedang di-QC. Setelah setiap fix, periksa seluruh caller/dependency yang terdampak agar perubahan tersebut tidak menciptakan regression baru.

Setelah seluruh temuan diperbaiki, lakukan **QC kedua dari awal seolah-olah kamu reviewer baru**. Jalankan semua validasi yang memang tersedia dan relevan di repository: unit/integration/e2e test, lint, type-check, build, targeted test, atau script validation lain yang aman dijalankan. Tambahkan atau perbaiki test jika terdapat critical behavior yang belum ter-cover, terutama untuk bug yang baru ditemukan, edge case penting, race condition, retry/idempotency, dan failure path. Jangan menyatakan suatu flow â€œverifiedâ€ jika hanya dibaca secara statis; bedakan dengan jelas antara static verification dan runtime verification. Jika ada bagian yang tidak dapat diuji karena membutuhkan credential, external service, environment, database, device, atau dependency tertentu, jangan mengarang hasilâ€”jelaskan apa yang belum bisa diuji, alasannya, risikonya, dan langkah verifikasi yang diperlukan.

Terakhir, lakukan final diff review dan pastikan tidak ada debug code, temporary flag, commented workaround, unused import, duplicate config, hardcoded value yang seharusnya shared/configurable, TODO kritis, inconsistent naming/type, secret, accidental logging, atau perubahan file yang tidak berkaitan. Hasil akhir harus berupa laporan yang spesifik dan dapat diaudit: scope yang diverifikasi, flow dan edge case yang diuji, temuan beserta root cause, perubahan yang dilakukan, file penting yang disentuh, command/test yang benar-benar dijalankan beserta hasilnya, limitation/residual risk, dan keputusan akhir **PASS / PASS WITH KNOWN LIMITATIONS / BLOCKED**. Jangan memberi status PASS hanya karena tidak menemukan error saat membaca code; PASS hanya jika implementasi sudah benar-benar cukup terverifikasi sesuai capability environment yang tersedia.

Sebelum mengubah code, baca kembali requirement/spec/dokumentasi yang relevan dan telusuri seluruh implementasi aktual di repository: file, route, API, service, controller, model, component, state, utility, config, dependency, permission, validation, persistence, asynchronous flow, dan integration point yang berkaitan dengan scope tersebut. Cocokkan actual code dengan intended behavior dan pola arsitektur existing. Jangan berasumsi code benar hanya karena compile, build, atau terlihat masuk akal; telusuri actual execution flow dari input/user action sampai hasil akhir dan pastikan tidak ada logic yang salah, duplikasi source of truth, konfigurasi yang bertentangan, dead code, insecure handling, coupling yang tidak perlu, behavior di luar requirement, atau implementasi yang diam-diam berbeda dari spec.

Lakukan QC secara aktif dengan mindset mencari kegagalan, bukan sekadar mencari alasan untuk PASS. Periksa happy path, invalid input, null/undefined, empty data, malformed payload/response, missing/invalid ID, unsupported value, timeout, network failure, partial failure, repeated action, double-click/double-submit, duplicate request, refresh/reload, navigation away, browser back/forward, stale state, race condition, async completion yang datang tidak berurutan, component unmount, retry, recovery, caching, pagination/limit, persistence, dan kondisi ketika satu bagian berhasil tetapi bagian berikutnya gagal. Periksa juga seluruh button, form, input, modal, dropdown, navigation, API request, loading/error/success/empty state, responsive behavior, access control, direct URL access, dan seluruh config/environment yang digunakan oleh scope tersebut.

Audit security dan data integrity secara khusus. Jangan mempercayai nilai penting hanya karena dikirim frontend; ownership, authorization, status, price/cost, privileged field, identifier, dan business rule penting harus diverifikasi di server/layer authoritative yang tepat. Untuk setiap bug, celah, missing handling, atau konfigurasi salah yang masih berada dalam scope, lakukan **root-cause analysis lalu langsung perbaiki** dengan perubahan sekecil, seaman, dan sekonsisten mungkin terhadap existing codebase. Jangan melakukan refactor besar yang tidak diperlukan, jangan membuat duplicate implementation baru jika reusable pattern sudah tersedia, jangan menambahkan fallback palsu untuk menyembunyikan error sebenarnya, dan jangan memperluas scope hanya karena menemukan unrelated issue. Jika menemukan masalah di luar scope, catat sebagai finding terpisah tanpa ikut mengubahnya kecuali benar-benar menjadi blocker untuk fitur yang sedang di-QC. Setelah setiap fix, periksa seluruh caller/dependency yang terdampak agar perubahan tersebut tidak menciptakan regression baru.

Setelah seluruh temuan diperbaiki, lakukan **QC kedua dari awal seolah-olah kamu reviewer baru**. Jalankan semua validasi yang memang tersedia dan relevan di repository: unit/integration/e2e test, lint, type-check, build, targeted test, atau script validation lain yang aman dijalankan. Tambahkan atau perbaiki test jika terdapat critical behavior yang belum ter-cover, terutama untuk bug yang baru ditemukan, edge case penting, race condition, retry/idempotency, dan failure path. def changed_files() -> list[str]:

Gunakan dan pertahankan **single source of truth** untuk logic, configuration, model/data mapping, business rule, constants, pricing/cost, capability, atau settings yang memang seharusnya shared. Jangan membuat duplicate implementation hanya agar pekerjaan lebih cepat selesai jika logic yang sama sudah tersedia atau seharusnya diekstrak menjadi reusable/shared layer. Hindari hardcode yang seharusnya configurable, jangan membuat hidden dependency, workaround rapuh, fake fallback, artificial delay, atau logic yang hanya menyembunyikan akar masalah. Jangan melakukan refactor besar terhadap unrelated code dan jangan menambahkan fitur tambahan yang tidak diminta. Jika menemukan masalah di luar scope, catat saja kecuali masalah tersebut benar-benar menjadi blocker terhadap implementasi yang sedang dikerjakan.

Setelah implementasi selesai, lakukan verifikasi nyata terhadap seluruh bagian yang disentuh. Jalankan test yang tersedia dan relevan, lint, type-check, build, unit/integration/e2e test, targeted test, atau validation script lain yang memang digunakan repository. Periksa juga semua caller/dependency yang terdampak agar perubahan tidak menyebabkan regression. Pastikan tidak ada console/runtime error, unhandled rejection, dead code, unused import, duplicate config, debug statement, credential/secret, temporary workaround, atau perubahan file yang tidak diperlukan. Jangan menyatakan fitur sudah bekerja jika hanya berdasarkan code inspection; bedakan dengan jelas antara bagian yang benar-benar diuji secara runtime dan bagian yang hanya diverifikasi secara statis. Jika environment, credential, database, device, atau external service tertentu tidak tersedia, jangan mengarang hasil test dan jelaskan limitation tersebut secara eksplisit.

Sebelum menyelesaikan pekerjaan, lakukan satu final review terhadap seluruh diff dan requirement untuk memastikan tidak ada poin spec yang tertinggal, tidak ada implementasi yang keluar scope, tidak ada behavior existing yang rusak, serta seluruh konfigurasi dan dependency konsisten. Setelah semuanya selesai, berikan laporan yang spesifik berisi: apa yang diimplementasikan, keputusan desain penting, file utama yang berubah, edge case yang ditangani, test/command yang benar-benar dijalankan beserta hasilnya, limitation atau residual risk bila ada, dan bagian yang sengaja tidak dikerjakan karena berada di luar scope. Jika instruksi pekerjaan meminta commit/push, lakukan hanya setelah implementasi dan testing selesai, gunakan commit yang jelas, push ke branch kerja yang ditentukan, dan jangan merge atau deploy kecuali diminta secara eksplisit.

psql_local() {
  docker exec -i \
    --env PGPASSWORD=postgres \
    "$container_id" \
    psql --no-psqlrc --set ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --username supabase_admin --dbname postgres "$@"
}

psql_migration() {
  # Supabase batches each migration transactionally. -1 needs -f (stdin alone
  # autocommits statements and drops ON COMMIT DROP tables before later use).
  # Keep this envelope off fixtures/contracts that own their transaction mode.
  psql_local --single-transaction --file=-
}

# Exercise the same replay function against this disposable database before
# restoring any application schema. The contract removes its synthetic schema.
source "$repo_root/scripts/ci/test-supabase-replay-transactions.sh"

echo "Restoring verified schema-only baseline into the isolated database"
psql_local <<'SQL'
DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS public CASCADE;
DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS storage CASCADE;
DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS auth CASCADE;
DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS subscription CASCADE;
DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS config CASCADE;
DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS private CASCADE;
DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS agent CASCADE;
-- Production has the vector extension installed in public. Supabase local
-- installs it in extensions, while a schema-filtered pg_dump records the
-- dependent public.vector types but not CREATE EXTENSION. Recreate that
-- production dependency before restoring the baseline.
CREATE SCHEMA public;
DROP EXTENSION IF EXISTS vector CASCADE;
CREATE EXTENSION vector WITH SCHEMA public;
SQL
# public was bootstrapped above so vector can exist before dependent functions
# and tables are restored. Read the verified Git blob, rather than the

psql_local() {
  docker exec -i \
    --env PGPASSWORD=postgres \
    "$container_id" \
    psql --no-psqlrc --set ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --username supabase_admin --dbname postgres "$@"
}

psql_migration() {
  # Supabase batches each migration transactionally. -1 needs -f (stdin alone
  # autocommits statements and drops ON COMMIT DROP tables before later use).
  # Keep this envelope off fixtures/contracts that own their transaction mode.
  psql_local --single-transaction --file=-
}

# Exercise the same replay function against this disposable database before
# restoring any application schema. The contract removes its synthetic schema.
source "$repo_root/scripts/ci/test-supabase-replay-transactions.sh"

echo "Restoring verified schema-only baseline into the isolated database"
psql_local <<'SQL'
DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS public CASCADE;
DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS storage CASCADE;
DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS auth CASCADE;
DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS subscription CASCADE;
DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS config CASCADE;
DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS private CASCADE;
DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS agent CASCADE;
-- Production has the vector extension installed in public. Supabase local
-- installs it in extensions, while a schema-filtered pg_dump records the
-- dependent public.vector types but not CREATE EXTENSION. Recreate that
-- production dependency before restoring the baseline.
CREATE SCHEMA public;
DROP EXTENSION IF EXISTS vector CASCADE;
CREATE EXTENSION vector WITH SCHEMA public;
SQL
# public was bootstrapped above so vector can exist before dependent functions
# and tables are restored. Read the verified Git blob, rather than the
# platform-normalized worktree copy, so CRLF checkout settings cannot invalidate
# a checked-in baseline or change the SQL that is restored.

psql_local() {
  docker exec -i \
    --env PGPASSWORD=postgres \
    "$container_id" \
    psql --no-psqlrc --set ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --username supabase_admin --dbname postgres "$@"
}

psql_migration() {
  # Supabase batches each migration transactionally. -1 needs -f (stdin alone
  # autocommits statements and drops ON COMMIT DROP tables before later use).
  # Keep this envelope off fixtures/contracts that own their transaction mode.
  psql_local --single-transaction --file=-
}

DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS public CASCADE;
DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS storage CASCADE;
DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS auth CASCADE;
DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS subscription CASCADE;
DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS config CASCADE;

-- production dependency before restoring the baseline.

SQL

psql_local() {
  docker exec -i \
    --env PGPASSWORD=postgres \
    "$container_id" \
    psql --no-psqlrc --set ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --username supabase_admin --dbname postgres "$@"
}

psql_migration() {
  # Supabase batches each migration transactionally. -1 needs -f (stdin alone
  # autocommits statements and drops ON COMMIT DROP tables before later use).
  # Keep this envelope off fixtures/contracts that own their transaction mode.
  psql_local --single-transaction --file=-
}

Periksa juga seluruh button, form, input, modal, dropdown, navigation, API request, loading/error/success/empty state, responsive behavior, access control, direct URL access, dan seluruh config/environment yang digunakan oleh scope tersebut.

Audit security dan data integrity secara khusus. Jangan mempercayai nilai penting hanya karena dikirim frontend; ownership, authorization, status, price/cost, privileged field, identifier, dan business rule penting harus diverifikasi di server/layer authoritative yang tepat. Pastikan tidak ada secret, credential, token, sensitive internal error, atau private data yang terekspos ke client atau log. Periksa juga idempotency, transaction boundary, failure semantics, retry behavior, concurrent request, dan consistency antara database/backend/frontend bila relevan. Jika ada operasi berbayar, irreversible, destructive, atau stateful, pastikan retry maupun transport failure tidak secara tidak sengaja menggandakan efeknya. Jangan menghapus validation/security atau melemahkan test hanya supaya fitur terlihat bekerja.

Untuk setiap bug, celah, missing handling, atau konfigurasi salah yang masih berada dalam scope, lakukan **root-cause analysis lalu langsung perbaiki** dengan perubahan sekecil, seaman, dan sekonsisten mungkin terhadap existing codebase. Jangan melakukan refactor besar yang tidak diperlukan, jangan membuat duplicate implementation baru jika reusable pattern sudah tersedia, jangan menambahkan fallback palsu untuk menyembunyikan error sebenarnya, dan jangan memperluas scope hanya karena menemukan unrelated issue. Jika menemukan masalah di luar scope, catat sebagai finding terpisah tanpa ikut mengubahnya kecuali benar-benar menjadi blocker untuk fitur yang sedang di-QC. Setelah setiap fix, periksa seluruh caller/dependency yang terdampak agar perubahan tersebut tidak menciptakan regression baru.

Setelah seluruh temuan diperbaiki, lakukan **QC kedua dari awal seolah-olah kamu reviewer baru**. Jalankan semua validasi yang memang tersedia dan relevan di repository: unit/integration/e2e test, lint, type-check, build, targeted test, atau script validation lain yang aman dijalankan. Tambahkan atau perbaiki test jika terdapat critical behavior yang belum ter-cover, terutama untuk bug yang baru ditemukan, edge case penting, race condition, retry/idempotency, dan failure path. Jangan menyatakan suatu flow â€œverifiedâ€ jika hanya dibaca secara statis; bedakan dengan jelas antara static verification dan runtime verification. Jika ada bagian yang tidak dapat diuji karena membutuhkan credential, external service, environment, database, device, atau dependency tertentu, jangan mengarang hasilâ€”jelaskan apa yang belum bisa diuji, alasannya, risikonya, dan langkah verifikasi yang diperlukan.

Terakhir, lakukan final diff review dan pastikan tidak ada debug code, temporary flag, commented workaround, unused import, duplicate config, hardcoded value yang seharusnya shared/configurable, TODO kritis, inconsistent naming/type, secret, accidental logging, atau perubahan file yang tidak berkaitan. Hasil akhir harus berupa laporan yang spesifik dan dapat diaudit: scope yang diverifikasi, flow dan edge case yang diuji, temuan beserta root cause, perubahan yang dilakukan, file penting yang disentuh, command/test yang benar-benar dijalankan beserta hasilnya, limitation/residual risk, dan keputusan akhir **PASS / PASS WITH KNOWN LIMITATIONS / BLOCKED**. Jangan memberi status PASS hanya karena tidak menemukan error saat membaca code; PASS hanya jika implementasi sudah benar-benar cukup terverifikasi sesuai capability environment yang tersedia.

psql_local() {
  docker exec -i \
    --env PGPASSWORD=postgres \
    "$container_id" \
    psql --no-psqlrc --set ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --username supabase_admin --dbname postgres "$@"
}

psql_migration() {
  # Supabase batches each migration transactionally. -1 needs -f (stdin alone
  # autocommits statements and drops ON COMMIT DROP tables before later use).
  # Keep this envelope off fixtures/contracts that own their transaction mode.
  psql_local --single-transaction --file=-
}

DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS public CASCADE;
DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS storage CASCADE;
DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS auth CASCADE;
DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS subscription CASCADE;
DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS config CASCADE;

SQL

function getReferenceImageNormalizationMetadata(
  metadata: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined
): ReferenceImageNormalizationMetadata | undefined {
  if (!metadata) return undefined
  const raw = metadata[REFERENCE_IMAGE_NORMALIZATION_METADATA_KEY]
  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object') return undefined

  const entry = raw as Record<string, unknown>
  const sourceReferenceImages = toStringArray(entry.sourceReferenceImages)
  const normalizedReferenceImages = toStringArray(
    entry.normalizedReferenceImages
  )
  const normalizedCount = toFiniteNumberOrUndefined(entry.normalizedCount) || 0
  const normalizedAt = toStringOrUndefined(entry.normalizedAt)

  if (normalizedReferenceImages.length === 0 || !normalizedAt) {
    return undefined
  }

  return {
    sourceReferenceImages,
    normalizedReferenceImages,
    normalizedCount,
    normalizedAt,
  }
}

function withReferenceImageNormalizationMetadata(
  metadata: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined,
  normalization: ReferenceImageNormalizationMetadata
): Record<string, unknown> {
  return {
    ...(metadata || {}),
    [REFERENCE_IMAGE_NORMALIZATION_METADATA_KEY]: normalization,
  }
}

function toProcessingProgress(
  state: ImageGenerationOrchestrationState
): number {
  // Keep progress bounded in processing range while async provider is still running.
  const base = state.activeTask ? 30 : 20
  const polls = state.activeTask?.pollAttempts || 0
  return Math.min(95, base + Math.floor(polls * 2))
}
