# Deliver QReed Change

Ship the exact reviewed change through risk-specific gates. Optimize for confidence per minute: never omit a required gate, and never repeat a gate that cannot add material evidence.

## 0. Operate as one delivery entrypoint

### Preserve the local-development boundary

Ordinary requests to implement, build, fix, change, continue, test, or QA a
feature authorize local workspace work only. They may include local edits,
focused tests, a localhost runtime, an SSH tunnel, and operator visual QA. They
do not authorize a commit, push, Pull Request, CI dispatch, merge, landing,
deployment, or production access. Stop after the requested local result and
report the current state.

Authorization does not cascade beyond the action named by the operator:

- `QA`, `verify`, `review`, or `is this ready?` authorizes read-only assessment
  and requested checks only; it does not authorize Git or remote mutations.
- `commit` authorizes a scoped local commit only, not a push or PR.
- `push` authorizes the required scoped commit when needed and a non-force push
  of the task branch, not a PR.
- `open a PR` authorizes the required scoped commit, branch push, and PR, not a
  merge or deployment.
- `merge`, `land`, or `deliver` authorizes the scoped delivery workflow to its
  declared non-production target.
- `deploy`, `go live`, or an expl<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="5009" />
End every authorized delivery report with this receipt. Do not force this
receipt onto ordinary implementation or local-QA reports. The receipt is a
floor, not a ceiling: keep its fields and order fixed so the operator can scan
it in seconds, and add extra judgment (context, corrections, warnings) outside
the receipt, never instead of it.

```markdown
## Delivery Receipt
- Verdict: ready to land | deployed and monitoring | not ready (<missing gate>) | blocked (<exact dependency>)
- Outcome: <1 sentence, user/business impact - what changes for users, not what the code does>
- Technical: <1-2 sentences: mechanism, invariants preserved> | SHA <sha> | PR <url>
- Gates: <one line per gate: name -> PASS/FAIL -> link to CI run / PR check / evidence>
- Skipped: <gate -> classifier reason> (or "none")
- Not proven automatically: <what the gates cannot cover - e.g. real-device Android behavior, visual judgment> (or "none")
- Manual check still needed from operator: <list, or "none">
- Radar: <task is DONE, but list what still stands from the surrounding arc -
  open follow-ups, pending flags/rollouts, uninvestigated warnings - and which
  one deserves attention first. "none" only if genuinely nothing stands.>
```

Rules for the receipt:

- `Outcome` and `Technical` are both mandatory: the operator scans `Outcome`
  first and only reads `Technical` to verify the mechanism matches intent.
- `Gates` lines are pass/fail plus a link; do not inline full commands or raw
  output (the link carries that).
- `Radar` is always present and always separate from the task verdict: a task
  can be DONE while the arc still has standing items. Never let radar items
  soften or blur the verdict, and never omit them because they are not urgent.
- `Manual check still needed` must be explicit so the operator never has to
  guess which smoke test remains theirs; device-specific and visual checks
  belong here when no automated gate covers them.

# 03 Ã¢â‚¬â€ Different surfaces, shared lifecycle

Parent: [senior architecture](2026-09-05-generation-unification.md).
Dependencies: shared catalog spec 00, admission/retry spec 01 and read/history spec 02.
Classification: core integration. Delivery is split into **stage 4 Canvas** and
**stage 5 Generate**, because their interaction and regression boundaries differ.

## Outcome and shared boundary

Canvas remains node/graph-driven. Generate remains form/card-driven. They share
typed job snapshots, immutable request identity, retry preparation and result
identity. Neither surface owns terminal status, provider dispatch or money.

Extract shared observation logic only where it removes duplicate semantics;
do not force one large hook/component to implement both products. Proposed
observation state is separate from job state: observing, reconnecting/session
unavailable, and idle. Progress/ETA remain presentation, not terminal authority.

Every async observer must validate subscription/attempt identity AFTER await,
not just before scheduling. Stop/start/unmount invalidates prior callbacks.
Out-of-order replies cannot regress the current observation. When no authoritative
revision exists, serialize reads per job and use a subscription epoch rather
than assuming client receipt time or `completed_at` establishes total ordering.
Allow the legitimate timeoutÃ¢â€ â€™completed late-attach transition.

## Stage 4 Ã¢â‚¬â€ Canvas binding and conditional application

### Shared catalog and request adapter

All public image/video generator consumers derive product/model choices, defaults,
controls and validation from spec 00. Specialized node presentations may remain,
but cannot keep separate business-rule lists. Resolve graph inputs into canonical
ordered references/settings, then c<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="1958" /> and server quotes.
- Same job viewed from either surface has identical state/accounting/result;
  global history includes both origins and Generate navigation needs no Canvas.

- Thirteen or more completed outputs; previously visible result leaves page one;
  no false finalizing state or endless list polling.
- Long-running video fails just before reload; card/history remains recoverable.
- Partial batch; retry one output; explicit cost; edit/retry input equality.
- Lost submit response, rapid repeated click, concurrent confirmation and reload.
- Out-of-order polling, auth expiry, transient read failure, dismiss failure.
- Late result from old timeout while a retry is queued/running/completed: both
  identities remain truthful, with no additional debit for late delivery.
- Image/video reference reuse across Generate and Canvas, no duplicate asset/job.

## Evidence and boundaries for junior handoff

For each stage: focused failing regression first, tests against real producer-shaped
snapshots, affected type-check, owned browser fixture flows and relevant existing
Canvas suites. Shared hook changes require all affected consumer suites, not
only newly authored tests. Database/concurrency evidence belongs to spec 01/02;
a mocked green UI test does not replace it.

Run heavy verification on the established H02/CI path after the appropriate
authorization. Use synthetic providers/QA fixtures; no live charge or production
data mutation. Exact integrated-commit evidence is required for delivery.

Junior does not choose new billing rules, change timeout constants, loosen RLS,
add a provider, invent missing schema, or claim full E2E from unit tests. Canvas
recovery refactoring IS in scope under the explicit binding contract above.

# 03 Ã¢â‚¬â€ Different surfaces, shared lifecycle

Parent: [senior architecture](2026-09-05-generation-unification.md).
Dependencies: shared catalog spec 00, admission/retry spec 01 and read/history spec 02.
Classification: core integration. Delivery is split into **stage 4 Canvas** and
**stage 5 Generate**, because their interaction and regression boundaries differ.

## Outcome and shared boundary

Canvas remains node/graph-driven. Generate remains form/card-driven. They share
typed job snapshots, immutable request identity, retry preparation and result
identity. Neither surface owns terminal status, provider dispatch or money.

Extract shared observation logic only where it removes duplicate semantics;
do not force one large hook/component to implement both products. Proposed
observation state is separate from job state: observing, reconnecting/session
unavailable, and idle. Progress/ETA remain presentation, not terminal authority.

Every async observer must validate subscription/attempt identity AFTER await,
not just before scheduling. Stop/start/unmount invalidates prior callbacks.
Out-of-order replies cannot regress the current observation. When no authoritative
revision exists, serialize reads per job and use a subscription epoch rather
than assuming client receipt time or `completed_at` establishes total ordering.
Allow the legitimate timeoutÃ¢â€ â€™completed late-attach transition.

## Stage 4 Ã¢â‚¬â€ Canvas binding and conditional application

### Shared catalog and request adapter

All public image/video generator consumers derive product/model choices, defaults,
controls and validation from spec 00. Specialized node presentations may remain,
but cannot keep separate business-rule lists. Resolve graph inputs into canonical
ordered references/settings, then c<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="1958" /> and server quotes.
- Same job viewed from either surface has identical state/accounting/result;
  global history includes both origins and Generate navigation needs no Canvas.

- Thirteen or more completed outputs; previously visible result leaves page one;
  no false finalizing state or endless list polling.
- Long-running video fails just before reload; card/history remains recoverable.
- Partial batch; retry one output; explicit cost; edit/retry input equality.
- Lost submit response, rapid repeated click, concurrent confirmation and reload.
- Out-of-order polling, auth expiry, transient read failure, dismiss failure.
- Late result from old timeout while a retry is queued/running/completed: both
  identities remain truthful, with no additional debit for late delivery.
- Image/video reference reuse across Generate and Canvas, no duplicate asset/job.

## Evidence and boundaries for junior handoff

For each stage: focused failing regression first, tests against real producer-shaped
snapshots, affected type-check, owned browser fixture flows and relevant existing
Canvas suites. Shared hook changes require all affected consumer suites, not
only newly authored tests. Database/concurrency evidence belongs to spec 01/02;
a mocked green UI test does not replace it.

Run heavy verification on the established H02/CI path after the appropriate
authorization. Use synthetic providers/QA fixtures; no live charge or production
data mutation. Exact integrated-commit evidence is required for delivery.

Junior does not choose new billing rules, change timeout constants, loosen RLS,
add a provider, invent missing schema, or claim full E2E from unit tests. Canvas
recovery refactoring IS in scope under the explicit binding contract above.
Junior submits concrete binding/admission designs for senior review before wiring
persisted-state and financial effects. No UI redesign, PWA work, Cancel feature or broad formatting in this scope.

# Deliver QReed Change

Ship the exact reviewed change through risk-specific gates. Optimize for confidence per minute: never omit a required gate, and never repeat a gate that cannot add material evidence.

## 0. Operate as one delivery entrypoint

### Preserve the local-development boundary

Ordinary requests to implement, build, fix, change, continue, test, or QA a
feature authorize local workspace work only. They may include local edits,
focused tests, a localhost runtime, an SSH tunnel, and operator visual QA. They
do not authorize a commit, push, Pull Request, CI dispatch, merge, landing,
deployment, or production access. Stop after the requested local result and
report the current state.

Authorization does not cascade beyond the action named by the operator:

- `QA`, `verify`, `review`, or `is this ready?` authorizes read-only assessment
  and requested checks only; it does not authorize Git or remote mutations.
- `commit` authorizes a scoped local commit only, not a push or PR.
- `push` authorizes the required scoped commit when needed and a non-force push
  of the task branch, not a PR.
- `open a PR` authorizes the required scoped commit, branch push, and PR, not a
  merge or deployment.
- `merge`, `land`, or `deliver` authorizes the scoped delivery workflow to its
  declared non-production target.
- `deploy`, `go live`, or an expl<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="5009" />
End every authorized delivery report with this receipt. Do not force this
receipt onto ordinary implementation or local-QA reports. The receipt is a
floor, not a ceiling: keep its fields and order fixed so the operator can scan
it in seconds, and add extra judgment (context, corrections, warnings) outside
the receipt, never instead of it.

```markdown
## Delivery Receipt
- Verdict: ready to land | deployed and monitoring | not ready (<missing gate>) | blocked (<exact dependency>)
- Outcome: <1 sentence, user/business impact - what changes for users, not what the code does>
- Technical: <1-2 sentences: mechanism, invariants preserved> | SHA <sha> | PR <url>
- Gates: <one line per gate: name -> PASS/FAIL -> link to CI run / PR check / evidence>
- Skipped: <gate -> classifier reason> (or "none")
- Not proven automatically: <what the gates cannot cover - e.g. real-device Android behavior, visual judgment> (or "none")
- Manual check still needed from operator: <list, or "none">
- Radar: <task is DONE, but list what still stands from the surrounding arc -
  open follow-ups, pending flags/rollouts, uninvestigated warnings - and which
  one deserves attention first. "none" only if genuinely nothing stands.>
```

Rules for the receipt:

- `Outcome` and `Technical` are both mandatory: the operator scans `Outcome`
  first and only reads `Technical` to verify the mechanism matches intent.
- `Gates` lines are pass/fail plus a link; do not inline full commands or raw
  output (the link carries that).
- `Radar` is always present and always separate from the task verdict: a task
  can be DONE while the arc still has standing items. Never let radar items
  soften or blur the verdict, and never omit them because they are not urgent.
- `Manual check still needed` must be explicit so the operator never has to
  guess which smoke test remains theirs; device-specific and visual checks
  belong here when no automated gate covers them.

def load_base_classifier() -> ModuleType:
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("qreed_ci_scope", BASE_CLASSIFIER_PATH)
    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Unable to load {BASE_CLASSIFIER_PATH}")
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


BASE_CLASSIFIER = load_base_classifier()

state stays outside the repository and must never be copied to Handy-CI.
Production QA remains opt-in.

## One-entry delivery behavior

`deliver-qreed-change` is the operator entrypoint. The operator does not choose
an executor:

- credential-free browser suites run once on Handy-CI;
- authenticated or interactive suites run once on Handy-Buildbox;
- Docker and ephemeral database gates run on their declared Handy-CI lane;
- exact-artifact receipts are reused instead of repeating a gate on another
  executor.

        'synthetic': sorted(synthetic), 'trusted': sorted(trusted),
        'coverage_gap': coverage_gap,
        'unmatched_paths': sorted(playwright_paths - matched_paths),
        'matched_paths': sorted(matched_paths),
    }


def adaptive_playwright_suites(
    paths: list[str], unresolved_diff: bool = False
) -> tuple[list[str], list[str], bool]:
    result = browser_coverage(paths, unresolved_diff)
    return result['synthetic'], result['trusted'], result['coverage_gap']


def playwright_executor(
    synthetic_suites: list[str], trusted_suites: list[str], coverage_gap: bool
) -> str:
    if coverage_gap:
        return "coverage-gap"
    if synthetic_suites and trusted_suites:
        return "mixed"
    if trusted_suites:
        return "handy-buildbox"

# Deliver QReed Change

Ship the exact reviewed change through risk-specific gates. Optimize for confidence per minute: never omit a required gate, and never repeat a gate that cannot add material evidence.

## 0. Operate as one delivery entrypoint

### Preserve the local-development boundary

Ordinary requests to implement, build, fix, change, continue, test, or QA a
feature authorize local workspace work only. They may include local edits,
focused tests, a localhost runtime, an SSH tunnel, and operator visual QA. They
do not authorize a commit, push, Pull Request, CI dispatch, merge, landing,
deployment, or production access. Stop after the requested local result and
report the current state.

Authorization does not cascade beyond the action named by the operator:

- `QA`, `verify`, `review`, or `is this ready?` authorizes read-only assessment
  and requested checks only; it does not authorize Git or remote mutations.
- `commit` authorizes a scoped local commit only, not a push or PR.
- `push` authorizes the required scoped commit when needed and a non-force push
  of the task branch, not a PR.
- `open a PR` authorizes the required scoped commit, branch push, and PR, not a
  merge or deployment.
- `merge`, `land`, or `deliver` authorizes the scoped delivery workflow to its
  declared non-production target.
- `deploy`, `go live`, or an expl<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="5009" />
End every authorized delivery report with this receipt. Do not force this
receipt onto ordinary implementation or local-QA reports. The receipt is a
floor, not a ceiling: keep its fields and order fixed so the operator can scan

the receipt, never instead of it.

```markdown
## Delivery Receipt
- Verdict: ready to land | deployed and monitoring | not ready (<missing gate>) | blocked (<exact dependency>)
- Outcome: <1 sentence, user/business impact - what changes for users, not what the code does>

  one deserves attention first. "none" only if genuinely nothing stands.>
```

Rules for the receipt:

- `Outcome` and `Technical` are both mandatory: the operator scans `Outcome`
  first and only reads `Technical` to verify the mechanism matches intent.
- `Gates` lines are pass/fail plus a link; do not inline full commands or raw

  can be DONE while the arc still has standing items. Never let radar items

The delivery planner contract tests ratchet this registry. A new Playwright
spec without a synthetic or trusted suite owner fails CI, and a synthetic spec
that remains registered after its file is removed also fails. Four pre-existing
unowned Canvas specs remain explicit debt:
AI Influencer Veo, download contract, locked credits, and Starter Pass offer.
The checker reports them on every run until focused suites are registered.

Handy-CI stores the complete adaptive plan on every PR and retains Playwright
trace, screenshot, video, and report artifacts when available. A green
unrelated suite does not close a coverage gap.

Buildbox QA uses an exact commit or explicit snapshot. Its saved authentication
state stays outside the repository and must never be copied to Handy-CI.
Production QA remains opt-in.

## One-entry delivery behavior

`deliver-qreed-change` is the operator entrypoint. The operator does not choose
an executor:

- credential-free browser suites run once on Handy-CI;
- authenticated or interactive suites run once on Handy-Buildbox;
- Docker and ephemeral database gates run on their declared Handy-CI lane;
- exact-artifact receipts are reused instead of repeating a gate on another
  executor.

The machine running the agent determines routing, not the screen displaying

def load_base_classifier() -> ModuleType:
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("qreed_ci_scope", BASE_CLASSIFIER_PATH)
    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Unable to load {BASE_CLASSIFIER_PATH}")
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module

The delivery planner contract tests ratchet this registry. A new Playwright
spec without a synthetic or trusted suite owner fails CI, and a synthetic spec
that remains registered after its file is removed also fails. Four pre-existing
unowned Canvas specs remain explicit debt:
AI Influencer Veo, download contract, locked credits, and Starter Pass offer.
The checker reports them on every run until focused suites are registered.

Handy-CI stores the complete adaptive plan on every PR and retains Playwright
trace, screenshot, video, and report artifacts when available. A green
unrelated suite does not close a coverage gap.

Buildbox QA uses an exact commit or explicit snapshot. Its saved authentication
state stays outside the repository and must never be copied to Handy-CI.
Production QA remains opt-in.

## One-entry delivery behavior

`deliver-qreed-change` is the operator entrypoint. The operator does not choose
an executor:

- credential-free browser suites run once on Handy-CI;
- authenticated or interactive suites run once on Handy-Buildbox;
- Docker and ephemeral database gates run on their declared Handy-CI lane;
- exact-artifact receipts are reused instead of repeating a gate on another
  executor.

The machine running the agent determines routing, not the screen displaying

def adaptive_playwright_suites(
    paths: list[str], unresolved_diff: bool = False
) -> tuple[list[str], list[str], bool]:
    result = browser_coverage(paths, unresolved_diff)
    return result['synthetic'], result['trusted'], result['coverage_gap']


def playwright_executor(
    synthetic_suites: list[str], trusted_suites: list[str], coverage_gap: bool
) -> str:
    if coverage_gap:
        return "coverage-gap"
    if synthetic_suites and trusted_suites:
        return "mixed"
    if trusted_suites:
        return "handy-buildbox"

                                      'DELIVERY_BASE_REF', 'DELIVERY_HEAD_REF'}}
    return subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, check=False, env=environment).returncode

    if not isinstance(value, list) or any(not isinstance(item, str) for item in value):

Setelah implementasi selesai, lakukan verifikasi nyata terhadap seluruh bagian yang disentuh. Jalankan test yang tersedia dan relevan, lint, type-check, build, unit/integration/e2e test, targeted test, atau validation script lain yang memang digunakan repository. Periksa juga semua caller/dependency yang terdampak agar perubahan tidak menyebabkan regression. Pastikan tidak ada console/runtime error, unhandled rejection, dead code, unused import, duplicate config, debug statement, credential/secret, temporary workaround, atau perubahan file yang tidak diperlukan. Jangan menyatakan fitur sudah bekerja jika hanya berdasarkan code inspection; bedakan dengan jelas antara bagian yang benar-benar diuji secara runtime dan bagian yang hanya diverifikasi secara statis. Jika environment, credential, database, device, atau external service tertentu tidak tersedia, jangan mengarang hasil test dan jelaskan limitation tersebut secara eksplisit.

Sebelum menyelesaikan pekerjaan, lakukan satu final review terhadap seluruh diff dan requirement untuk memastikan tidak ada poin spec yang tertinggal, tidak ada implementasi yang keluar scope, tidak ada behavior existing yang rusak, serta seluruh konfigurasi dan dependency konsisten. Setelah semuanya selesai, berikan laporan yang spesifik berisi: apa yang diimplementasikan, keputusan desain penting, file utama yang berubah, edge case yang ditangani, test/command yang benar-benar dijalankan beserta hasilnya, limitation atau residual risk bila ada, dan bagian yang sengaja tidak dikerjakan karena berada di luar scope. Jika instruksi pekerjaan meminta commit/push, lakukan hanya setelah implementasi dan testing selesai, gunakan commit yang jelas, push ke branch kerja yang ditentukan, dan jangan merge atau deploy kecuali diminta secara eksplisit.

/**
 * A display origin is deliberately wider than the origin accepted on a new
 * submission. `legacy` means that the persisted row does not contain enough
 * evidence to call it Canvas or Generate.
 */
export type GenerationReadOrigin = 'canvas' | 'generate' | 'legacy'
export type GenerationOriginFilter = 'all' | 'canvas' | 'generate'
export type GenerationOriginEvidence =
  | 'explicit_metadata'
  | 'legacy_create_node'
  | 'legacy_canvas_context'
  | 'legacy_unknown'

export interface GenerationOriginInput {
  canvasId?: string | null
  nodeId?: string | null
  resultMetadata?: unknown
}

export interface ResolvedGenerationOrigin {
  origin: GenerationReadOrigin
  evidence: GenerationOriginEvidence
}

function explicitOrigin(metadata: unknown): 'canvas' | 'generate' | null {
  if (!metadata || typeof metadata !== 'object' || Array.isArray(metadata)) {
    return null
  }
  const value = (metadata as Record<string, unknown>).generation_origin
  return value === 'canvas' || value === 'generate' ? value : null
}

/**
 * The only origin classifier used by projections and SQL scopes. A non-create

 * compatible rather than being silently relabelled.

Jangan menyatakan fitur sudah bekerja jika hanya berdasarkan code inspection; bedakan dengan jelas antara bagian yang benar-benar diuji secara runtime dan bagian yang hanya diverifikasi secara statis. Jika environment, credential, database, device, atau external service tertentu tidak tersedia, jangan mengarang hasil test dan jelaskan limitation tersebut secara eksplisit.

Sebelum menyelesaikan pekerjaan, lakukan satu final review terhadap seluruh diff dan requirement untuk memastikan tidak ada poin spec yang tertinggal, tidak ada implementasi yang keluar scope, tidak ada behavior existing yang rusak, serta seluruh konfigurasi dan dependency konsisten. Setelah semuanya selesai, berikan laporan yang spesifik berisi: apa yang diimplementasikan, keputusan desain penting, file utama yang berubah, edge case yang ditangani, test/command yang benar-benar dijalankan beserta hasilnya, limitation atau residual risk bila ada, dan bagian yang sengaja tidak dikerjakan karena berada di luar scope. Jika instruksi pekerjaan meminta commit/push, lakukan hanya setelah implementasi dan testing selesai, gunakan commit yang jelas, push ke branch kerja yang ditentukan, dan jangan merge atau deploy kecuali diminta secara eksplisit.

import { GENERATION_STATUS } from '@/lib/constants/status'

/**
 * Terminal Create rows exist only while the worker result is handed off to
 * Recent. Keeping this finite prevents an old failure or completed record from
 * becoming a permanent loading/attention card after every page reload.
 */
export const DIRECT_GENERATE_TERMINAL_RECONCILIATION_WINDOW_MS = 10 * 60 * 1000

const ACTIVE_STATUSES = [
  GENERATION_STATUS.QUEUED,
  GENERATION_STATUS.PROCESSING,
] as const
const TERMINAL_STATUSES = [
  GENERATION_STATUS.COMPLETED,
  GENERATION_STATUS.FAILED,
  GENERATION_STATUS.TIMEOUT,
] as const

export function getDirectGenerateTerminalCutoff(now = Date.now()): string {
  return new Date(
    now - DIRECT_GENERATE_TERMINAL_RECONCILIATION_WINDOW_MS
  ).toISOString()
}

/** PostgREST filter: every active row, plus only recent terminal rows. */
export function getDirectGenerateRestorationFilter(cutoff: string): string {
  return `status.in.(${ACTIVE_STATUSES.join(',')}),and(status.in.(${TERMINAL_STATUSES.join(',')}),created_at.gte.${cutoff})`
}

export function shouldRestoreDirectGenerateRow(
  status: string | null | undefined,
  createdAt: string | null | undefined,
  now = Date.now()
): boolean {
  if (ACTIVE_STATUSES.includes(status as (typeof ACTIVE_STATUSES)[number])) {
    return true
  }
  if (
    !TERMINAL_STATUSES.includes(status as (typeof TERMINAL_STATUSES)[number])
  ) {
    return false
  }

  const createdAtMs = Date.parse(createdAt || '')
  return (
    Number.isFinite(createdAtMs) &&
    createdAtMs >= now - DIRECT_GENERATE_TERMINAL_RECONCILIATION_WINDOW_MS
  )
}

Jangan melakukan refactor besar yang tidak diperlukan, jangan membuat duplicate implementation baru jika reusable pattern sudah tersedia, jangan menambahkan fallback palsu untuk menyembunyikan error sebenarnya, dan jangan memperluas scope hanya karena menemukan unrelated issue. export interface UseAssetActivityResult {
  activity: AssetActivityItem[]
  isLoading: boolean
  isError: boolean
  /** For a compact caller that supplies a route or load-more UI. */
  hasMore: boolean
  nextCursor: string | null
  dismissActivity: (item: AssetActivityItem) => Promise<void>
  dismissingIds: Set<string>
}

async function fetchAssetActivity(key: string): Promise<AssetActivityResponse> {
  const [, source] = key.split(':')
  const result = await getAssetActivityAction({
    limit: 4,
    source:
      source === 'canvas' ||
      source === 'generate' ||
      source === 'legacy' ||
      source === 'instant'
        ? source
        : 'all',
  })
  if (!result.success) {
    throw new Error(result.error || 'Failed to load asset activity')
  }
  return {
    activity: result.activity || [],
    hasMore: result.hasMore === true,
    nextCursor: result.nextCursor || null,
  }
}

type InstantActivityStripProps = {
  /** Allows deterministic recovery fixtures without opening a server read. */
  activityOverride?: Pick<
    UseAssetActivityResult,
    'activity' | 'isError' | 'dismissingIds' | 'dismissActivity'
  >
}

export function InstantActivityStrip({
  activityOverride,
}: InstantActivityStripProps) {
  const liveActivity = useAssetActivity({
    source: 'instant',
    enabled: !activityOverride,
  })
  const activity = activityOverride ?? liveActivity

  if (activity.activity.length === 0) {
    if (!activity.isError) return null
    return (
      <div className="mx-auto mt-8 max-w-4xl" role="alert">
        <p className="text-sm text-stone-500 dark:text-zinc-400">
          Activity could not refresh. Try again shortly.
        </p>
      </div>
    )
  }

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto mt-8 max-w-4xl">
      {activity.isError && (
        <p
          className="mb-3 text-sm text-stone-500 dark:text-zinc-400"
          role="alert"
        >
          Activity may be out of date. It will retry automatically.
        </p>
      )}
      <AssetActivityRail
        items={activity.activity}
        dismissingIds={activity.dismissingIds}
        onDismiss={(item) => {
          activity.dismissActivity(item).catch(() => {})
        }}
      />
    </div>
  )
}

      .from('instant_try_sessions')
      .update({ activity_dismissed_at: null })

      .eq('user_id', user.id)
      .not('activity_dismissed_at', 'is', null)

      return { success: false, error: sanitizeErrorMessage(error.message) }
    }
    return { success: true }

      success: false,

    }
  }

Periksa juga seluruh button, form, input, modal, dropdown, navigation, API request, loading/error/success/empty state, responsive behavior, access control, direct URL access, dan seluruh config/environment yang digunakan oleh scope tersebut.

Audit security dan data integrity secara khusus. Jangan mempercayai nilai penting hanya karena dikirim frontend; ownership, authorization, status, price/cost, privileged field, identifier, dan business rule penting harus diverifikasi di server/layer authoritative yang tepat. Pastikan tidak ada secret, credential, token, sensitive internal error, atau private data yang terekspos ke client atau log. Periksa juga idempotency, transaction boundary, failure semantics, retry behavior, concurrent request, dan consistency antara database/backend/frontend bila relevan. Jika ada operasi berbayar, irreversible, destructive, atau stateful, pastikan retry maupun transport failure tidak secara tidak sengaja menggandakan efeknya. Jangan menghapus validation/security atau melemahkan test hanya supaya fitur terlihat bekerja.

Untuk setiap bug, celah, missing handling, atau konfigurasi salah yang masih berada dalam scope, lakukan **root-cause analysis lalu langsung perbaiki** dengan perubahan sekecil, seaman, dan sekonsisten mungkin terhadap existing codebase. Jangan melakukan refactor besar yang tidak diperlukan, jangan membuat duplicate implementation baru jika reusable pattern sudah tersedia, jangan menambahkan fallback palsu untuk menyembunyikan error sebenarnya, dan jangan memperluas scope hanya karena menemukan unrelated issue. Jika menemukan masalah di luar scope, catat sebagai finding terpisah tanpa ikut mengubahnya kecuali benar-benar menjadi blocker untuk fitur yang sedang di-QC. Setelah setiap fix, periksa seluruh caller/dependency yang terdampak agar perubahan tersebut tidak menciptakan regression baru.

Setelah seluruh temuan diperbaiki, lakukan **QC kedua dari awal seolah-olah kamu reviewer baru**. Jalankan semua validasi yang memang tersedia dan relevan di repository: unit/integration/e2e test, lint, type-check, build, targeted test, atau script validation lain yang aman dijalankan. Tambahkan atau perbaiki test jika terdapat critical behavior yang belum ter-cover, terutama untuk bug yang baru ditemukan, edge case penting, race condition, retry/idempotency, dan failure path. Jangan menyatakan suatu flow â€œverifiedâ€ jika hanya dibaca secara statis; bedakan dengan jelas antara static verification dan runtime verification. Jika ada bagian yang tidak dapat diuji karena membutuhkan credential, external service, environment, database, device, atau dependency tertentu, jangan mengarang hasilâ€”jelaskan apa yang belum bisa diuji, alasannya, risikonya, dan langkah verifikasi yang diperlukan.

Terakhir, lakukan final diff review dan pastikan tidak ada debug code, temporary flag, commented workaround, unused import, duplicate config, hardcoded value yang seharusnya shared/configurable, TODO kritis, inconsistent naming/type, secret, accidental logging, atau perubahan file yang tidak berkaitan. Hasil akhir harus berupa laporan yang spesifik dan dapat diaudit: scope yang diverifikasi, flow dan edge case yang diuji, temuan beserta root cause, perubahan yang dilakukan, file penting yang disentuh, command/test yang benar-benar dijalankan beserta hasilnya, limitation/residual risk, dan keputusan akhir **PASS / PASS WITH KNOWN LIMITATIONS / BLOCKED**. Jangan memberi status PASS hanya karena tidak menemukan error saat membaca code; PASS hanya jika implementasi sudah benar-benar cukup terverifikasi sesuai capability environment yang tersedia.

# Deliver QReed Change

Ship the exact reviewed change through risk-specific gates. Optimize for confidence per minute: never omit a required gate, and never repeat a gate that cannot add material evidence.

## 0. Operate as one delivery entrypoint

### Preserve the local-development boundary

Ordinary requests to implement, build, fix, change, continue, test, or QA a
feature authorize local workspace work only. They may include local edits,
focused tests, a localhost runtime, an SSH tunnel, and operator visual QA. They
do not authorize a commit, push, Pull Request, CI dispatch, merge, landing,
deployment, or production access. Stop after the requested local result and
report the current state.

Authorization does not cascade beyond the action named by the operator:

- `QA`, `verify`, `review`, or `is this ready?` authorizes read-only assessment
  and requested checks only; it does not authorize Git or remote mutations.
- `commit` authorizes a scoped local commit only, not a push or PR.
- `push` authorizes the required scoped commit when needed and a non-force push
  of the task branch, not a PR.
- `open a PR` authorizes the required scoped commit, branch push, and PR, not a
  merge or deployment.
- `merge`, `land`, or `deliver` authorizes the scoped delivery workflow to its
  declared non-production target.
- `deploy`, `go live`, or an expl<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="5009" />
End every authorized delivery report with this receipt. Do not force this
receipt onto ordinary implementation or local-QA reports. The receipt is a
floor, not a ceiling: keep its fields and order fixed so the operator can scan
it in seconds, and add extra judgment (context, corrections, warnings) outside
the receipt, never instead of it.

```markdown
## Delivery Receipt
- Verdict: ready to land | deployed and monitoring | not ready (<missing gate>) | blocked (<exact dependency>)
- Outcome: <1 sentence, user/business impact - what changes for users, not what the code does>
- Technical: <1-2 sentences: mechanism, invariants preserved> | SHA <sha> | PR <url>
- Gates: <one line per gate: name -> PASS/FAIL -> link to CI run / PR check / evidence>
- Skipped: <gate -> classifier reason> (or "none")
- Not proven automatically: <what the gates cannot cover - e.g. real-device Android behavior, visual judgment> (or "none")
- Manual check still needed from operator: <list, or "none">
- Radar: <task is DONE, but list what still stands from the surrounding arc -
  open follow-ups, pending flags/rollouts, uninvestigated warnings - and which
  one deserves attention first. "none" only if genuinely nothing stands.>
```

Rules for the receipt:

- `Outcome` and `Technical` are both mandatory: the operator scans `Outcome`
  first and only reads `Technical` to verify the mechanism matches intent.
- `Gates` lines are pass/fail plus a link; do not inline full commands or raw
  output (the link carries that).
- `Radar` is always present and always separate from the task verdict: a task
  can be DONE while the arc still has standing items. Never let radar items
  soften or blur the verdict, and never omit them because they are not urgent.
- `Manual check still needed` must be explicit so the operator never has to
  guess which smoke test remains theirs; device-specific and visual checks
  belong here when no automated gate covers them.

# Deliver QReed Change

Ship the exact reviewed change through risk-specific gates. Optimize for confidence per minute: never omit a required gate, and never repeat a gate that cannot add material evidence.

## 0. Operate as one delivery entrypoint

### Preserve the local-development boundary

Ordinary requests to implement, build, fix, change, continue, test, or QA a
feature authorize local workspace work only. They may include local edits,
focused tests, a localhost runtime, an SSH tunnel, and operator visual QA. They
do not authorize a commit, push, Pull Request, CI dispatch, merge, landing,
deployment, or production access. Stop after the requested local result and
report the current state.

Authorization does not cascade beyond the action named by the operator:

- `QA`, `verify`, `review`, or `is this ready?` authorizes read-only assessment
  and requested checks only; it does not authorize Git or remote mutations.
- `commit` authorizes a scoped local commit only, not a push or PR.
- `push` authorizes the required scoped commit when needed and a non-force push
  of the task branch, not a PR.
- `open a PR` authorizes the required scoped commit, branch push, and PR, not a
  merge or deployment.
- `merge`, `land`, or `deliver` authorizes the scoped delivery workflow to its
  declared non-production target.
- `deploy`, `go live`, or an expl<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="5009" />
End every authorized delivery report with this receipt. Do not force this
receipt onto ordinary implementation or local-QA reports. The receipt is a
floor, not a ceiling: keep its fields and order fixed so the operator can scan
it in seconds, and add extra judgment (context, corrections, warnings) outside
the receipt, never instead of it.

```markdown
## Delivery Receipt
- Verdict: ready to land | deployed and monitoring | not ready (<missing gate>) | blocked (<exact dependency>)
- Outcome: <1 sentence, user/business impact - what changes for users, not what the code does>
- Technical: <1-2 sentences: mechanism, invariants preserved> | SHA <sha> | PR <url>
- Gates: <one line per gate: name -> PASS/FAIL -> link to CI run / PR check / evidence>
- Skipped: <gate -> classifier reason> (or "none")
- Not proven automatically: <what the gates cannot cover - e.g. real-device Android behavior, visual judgment> (or "none")
- Manual check still needed from operator: <list, or "none">
- Radar: <task is DONE, but list what still stands from the surrounding arc -
  open follow-ups, pending flags/rollouts, uninvestigated warnings - and which
  one deserves attention first. "none" only if genuinely nothing stands.>
```

Rules for the receipt:

- `Outcome` and `Technical` are both mandatory: the operator scans `Outcome`
  first and only reads `Technical` to verify the mechanism matches intent.
- `Gates` lines are pass/fail plus a link; do not inline full commands or raw
  output (the link carries that).
- `Radar` is always present and always separate from the task verdict: a task
  can be DONE while the arc still has standing items. Never let radar items
  soften or blur the verdict, and never omit them because they are not urgent.
- `Manual check still needed` must be explicit so the operator never has to
  guess which smoke test remains theirs; device-specific and visual checks
  belong here when no automated gate covers them.

# Deliver QReed Change

Ship the exact reviewed change through risk-specific gates. Optimize for confidence per minute: never omit a required gate, and never repeat a gate that cannot add material evidence.

## 0. Operate as one delivery entrypoint

### Preserve the local-development boundary

Ordinary requests to implement, build, fix, change, continue, test, or QA a
feature authorize local workspace work only. They may include local edits,
focused tests, a localhost runtime, an SSH tunnel, and operator visual QA. They
do not authorize a commit, push, Pull Request, CI dispatch, merge, landing,
deployment, or production access. Stop after the requested local result and
report the current state.

Authorization does not cascade beyond the action named by the operator:

- `QA`, `verify`, `review`, or `is this ready?` authorizes read-only assessment
  and requested checks only; it does not authorize Git or remote mutations.
- `commit` authorizes a scoped local commit only, not a push or PR.
- `push` authorizes the required scoped commit when needed and a non-force push
  of the task branch, not a PR.
- `open a PR` authorizes the required scoped commit, branch push, and PR, not a
  merge or deployment.
- `merge`, `land`, or `deliver` authorizes the scoped delivery workflow to its
  declared non-production target.
- `deploy`, `go live`, or an expl<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="5009" />
End every authorized delivery report with this receipt. Do not force this
receipt onto ordinary implementation or local-QA reports. The receipt is a
floor, not a ceiling: keep its fields and order fixed so the operator can scan
it in seconds, and add extra judgment (context, corrections, warnings) outside
the receipt, never instead of it.

```markdown
## Delivery Receipt
- Verdict: ready to land | deployed and monitoring | not ready (<missing gate>) | blocked (<exact dependency>)
- Outcome: <1 sentence, user/business impact - what changes for users, not what the code does>
- Technical: <1-2 sentences: mechanism, invariants preserved> | SHA <sha> | PR <url>
- Gates: <one line per gate: name -> PASS/FAIL -> link to CI run / PR check / evidence>
- Skipped: <gate -> classifier reason> (or "none")
- Not proven automatically: <what the gates cannot cover - e.g. real-device Android behavior, visual judgment> (or "none")
- Manual check still needed from operator: <list, or "none">
- Radar: <task is DONE, but list what still stands from the surrounding arc -
  open follow-ups, pending flags/rollouts, uninvestigated warnings - and which
  one deserves attention first. "none" only if genuinely nothing stands.>
```

Rules for the receipt:

- `Outcome` and `Technical` are both mandatory: the operator scans `Outcome`
  first and only reads `Technical` to verify the mechanism matches intent.
- `Gates` lines are pass/fail plus a link; do not inline full commands or raw
  output (the link carries that).
- `Radar` is always present and always separate from the task verdict: a task
  can be DONE while the arc still has standing items. Never let radar items
  soften or blur the verdict, and never omit them because they are not urgent.
- `Manual check still needed` must be explicit so the operator never has to
  guess which smoke test remains theirs; device-specific and visual checks
  belong here when no automated gate covers them.

# Deliver QReed Change

Ship the exact reviewed change through risk-specific gates. Optimize for confidence per minute: never omit a required gate, and never repeat a gate that cannot add material evidence.

## 0. Operate as one delivery entrypoint

### Preserve the local-development boundary

Ordinary requests to implement, build, fix, change, continue, test, or QA a
feature authorize local workspace work only. They may include local edits,
focused tests, a localhost runtime, an SSH tunnel, and operator visual QA. They
do not authorize a commit, push, Pull Request, CI dispatch, merge, landing,
deployment, or production access. Stop after the requested local result and
report the current state.

Authorization does not cascade beyond the action named by the operator:

- `QA`, `verify`, `review`, or `is this ready?` authorizes read-only assessment
  and requested checks only; it does not authorize Git or remote mutations.
- `commit` authorizes a scoped local commit only, not a push or PR.
- `push` authorizes the required scoped commit when needed and a non-force push
  of the task branch, not a PR.
- `open a PR` authorizes the required scoped commit, branch push, and PR, not a
  merge or deployment.
- `merge`, `land`, or `deliver` authorizes the scoped delivery workflow to its
  declared non-production target.
- `deploy`, `go live`, or an expl<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="5009" />
End every authorized delivery report with this receipt. Do not force this
receipt onto ordinary implementation or local-QA reports. The receipt is a
floor, not a ceiling: keep its fields and order fixed so the operator can scan
it in seconds, and add extra judgment (context, corrections, warnings) outside
the receipt, never instead of it.

```markdown
## Delivery Receipt
- Verdict: ready to land | deployed and monitoring | not ready (<missing gate>) | blocked (<exact dependency>)
- Outcome: <1 sentence, user/business impact - what changes for users, not what the code does>
- Technical: <1-2 sentences: mechanism, invariants preserved> | SHA <sha> | PR <url>
- Gates: <one line per gate: name -> PASS/FAIL -> link to CI run / PR check / evidence>
- Skipped: <gate -> classifier reason> (or "none")
- Not proven automatically: <what the gates cannot cover - e.g. real-device Android behavior, visual judgment> (or "none")
- Manual check still needed from operator: <list, or "none">
- Radar: <task is DONE, but list what still stands from the surrounding arc -
  open follow-ups, pending flags/rollouts, uninvestigated warnings - and which
  one deserves attention first. "none" only if genuinely nothing stands.>
```

Rules for the receipt:

- `Outcome` and `Technical` are both mandatory: the operator scans `Outcome`
  first and only reads `Technical` to verify the mechanism matches intent.
- `Gates` lines are pass/fail plus a link; do not inline full commands or raw
  output (the link carries that).
- `Radar` is always present and always separate from the task verdict: a task
  can be DONE while the arc still has standing items. Never let radar items
  soften or blur the verdict, and never omit them because they are not urgent.
- `Manual check still needed` must be explicit so the operator never has to
  guess which smoke test remains theirs; device-specific and visual checks
  belong here when no automated gate covers them.

# Deliver QReed Change

Ship the exact reviewed change through risk-specific gates. Optimize for confidence per minute: never omit a required gate, and never repeat a gate that cannot add material evidence.

## 0. Operate as one delivery entrypoint

### Preserve the local-development boundary

Ordinary requests to implement, build, fix, change, continue, test, or QA a
feature authorize local workspace work only. They may include local edits,
focused tests, a localhost runtime, an SSH tunnel, and operator visual QA. They
do not authorize a commit, push, Pull Request, CI dispatch, merge, landing,
deployment, or production access. Stop after the requested local result and
report the current state.

Authorization does not cascade beyond the action named by the operator:

- `QA`, `verify`, `review`, or `is this ready?` authorizes read-only assessment
  and requested checks only; it does not authorize Git or remote mutations.
- `commit` authorizes a scoped local commit only, not a push or PR.
- `push` authorizes the required scoped commit when needed and a non-force push
  of the task branch, not a PR.
- `open a PR` authorizes the required scoped commit, branch push, and PR, not a
  merge or deployment.
- `merge`, `land`, or `deliver` authorizes the scoped delivery workflow to its
  declared non-production target.
- `deploy`, `go live`, or an expl<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="5009" />

receipt onto ordinary implementation or local-QA reports. The receipt is a
floor, not a ceiling: keep its fields and order fixed so the operator can scan
it in seconds, and add extra judgment (context, corrections, warnings) outside
the receipt, never instead of it.

```markdown
## Delivery Receipt
- Verdict: ready to land | deployed and monitoring | not ready (<missing gate>) | blocked (<exact dependency>)
- Outcome: <1 sentence, user/business impact - what changes for users, not what the code does>
- Technical: <1-2 sentences: mechanism, invariants preserved> | SHA <sha> | PR <url>
- Gates: <one line per gate: name -> PASS/FAIL -> link to CI run / PR check / evidence>
- Skipped: <gate -> classifier reason> (or "none")
- Not proven automatically: <what the gates cannot cover - e.g. real-device Android behavior, visual judgment> (or "none")
- Manual check still needed from operator: <list, or "none">
- Radar: <task is DONE, but list what still stands from the surrounding arc -
  open follow-ups, pending flags/rollouts, uninvestigated warnings - and which
  one deserves attention first. "none" only if genuinely nothing stands.>
```

Rules for the receipt:

- `Outcome` and `Technical` are both mandatory: the operator scans `Outcome`
  first and only reads `Technical` to verify the mechanism matches intent.
- `Gates` lines are pass/fail plus a link; do not inline full commands or raw
  output (the link carries that).
- `Radar` is always present and always separate from the task verdict: a task
  can be DONE while the arc still has standing items. Never let radar items
  soften or blur the verdict, and never omit them because they are not urgent.
- `Manual check still needed` must be explicit so the operator never has to
  guess which smoke test remains theirs; device-specific and visual checks
  belong here when no automated gate covers them.

1. Konsep Utama Paling Penting
Zero Economy: Hapus semua logika soal budget, beli item, atau tebusan uang. Game ini 100% tentang Hitman yang menyusup dan menyandera warga secara diam-diam, sementara warga berusaha menebak siapa Hitman-nya lewat observasi chat.

2. Pembagian Role & Kemampuan
HITMAN (Jahat): Tugasnya menyandera semua orang. Saat Malam, dia memilih 1 korban untuk di- Hostage. Saat Siang, dia punya keahlian khusus Gag Order (bisa membungkam chat 1 orang, cooldown 1 ronde).
SPY (Warga - Pelindung): Tugasnya melindungi warga. Saat Malam, memilih 1 orang untuk dikawal (Guard). Jika orang itu diserang Hitman, aksi Hostage gagal. Syaratnya: tidak boleh mengawal orang yang sama 2 malam berturut-turut.
STALKER (Warga - Intel): Tugasnya mencari informasi. Saat Malam, bisa menerawang (Peek) identitas asli 1 pemain. Sangat OP, makanya punya cooldown lambat (cuma bisa dipakai 1x setiap 2 ronde).
CIVILIAN (Warga - Biasa): Tidak punya skill malam. Modalnya cuma berdebat di chat dan melakukan observasi siapa yang paling mencurigakan.

3. Alur Permainan Per Ronde (The Game Loop)
Fase Siang (Day - Diskusi): Semua orang berdebat di kolom chat selama sekian menit. Di momen ini, Hitman bisa diam-diam memencet tombol Gag Order untuk membisukan satu pemain secara mendadak demi menebar fitnah.
Fase Malam (Night - Aksi): Layar meredup, chat dikunci. Hitman menargetkan korban Hostage, Spy memasang tameng (Guard), dan Stalker mengintip identitas (Peek). Semua aksi dilakukan buta tanpa tahu pergerakan satu sama lain.
Fase Tribunal (Voting): Pagi tiba. Sistem akan merekap pergerakan semalam (tanpa menyebut nama target). Semua pemain yang masih bisa bicara akan melakukan voting. Pemain dengan vote terbanyak akan langsung dieksekusi mati oleh sistem. Ronde berulang.

4. Dua Mekanik Inti (Core Mechanics)
Efek Hostage: Korban yang sukses disandera oleh Hitman tidak mati di layar, tapi suaranya dihilangkan. Mereka sama sekali tidak bisa ngetik di chat dan hak voting-nya hangus.

1. Konsep Utama Paling Penting
Zero Economy: Hapus semua logika soal budget, beli item, atau tebusan uang. Game ini 100% tentang Hitman yang menyusup dan menyandera warga secara diam-diam, sementara warga berusaha menebak siapa Hitman-nya lewat observasi chat.

2. Pembagian Role & Kemampuan
HITMAN (Jahat): Tugasnya menyandera semua orang. Saat Malam, dia memilih 1 korban untuk di- Hostage. Saat Siang, dia punya keahlian khusus Gag Order (bisa membungkam chat 1 orang, cooldown 1 ronde).
SPY (Warga - Pelindung): Tugasnya melindungi warga. Saat Malam, memilih 1 orang untuk dikawal (Guard). Jika orang itu diserang Hitman, aksi Hostage gagal. Syaratnya: tidak boleh mengawal orang yang sama 2 malam berturut-turut.
STALKER (Warga - Intel): Tugasnya mencari informasi. Saat Malam, bisa menerawang (Peek) identitas asli 1 pemain. Sangat OP, makanya punya cooldown lambat (cuma bisa dipakai 1x setiap 2 ronde).
CIVILIAN (Warga - Biasa): Tidak punya skill malam. Modalnya cuma berdebat di chat dan melakukan observasi siapa yang paling mencurigakan.

3. Alur Permainan Per Ronde (The Game Loop)
Fase Siang (Day - Diskusi): Semua orang berdebat di kolom chat selama sekian menit. Di momen ini, Hitman bisa diam-diam memencet tombol Gag Order untuk membisukan satu pemain secara mendadak demi menebar fitnah.
Fase Malam (Night - Aksi): Layar meredup, chat dikunci. Hitman menargetkan korban Hostage, Spy memasang tameng (Guard), dan Stalker mengintip identitas (Peek). Semua aksi dilakukan buta tanpa tahu pergerakan satu sama lain.
Fase Tribunal (Voting): Pagi tiba. Sistem akan merekap pergerakan semalam (tanpa menyebut nama target). Semua pemain yang masih bisa bicara akan melakukan voting. Pemain dengan vote terbanyak akan langsung dieksekusi mati oleh sistem. Ronde berulang.

4. Dua Mekanik Inti (Core Mechanics)
Efek Hostage: Korban yang sukses disandera oleh Hitman tidak mati di layar, tapi suaranya dihilangkan. Mereka sama sekali tidak bisa ngetik di chat dan hak voting-nya hangus.
Silent Terror: Sistem TIDAK PERNAH mengumumkan siapa yang kena Hostage. Kalau ada pemain yang tiba-tiba diam tidak membalas chat, pemain lain harus peka dan menebak: apakah dia kena Hostage, kena Gag Order, atau murni lagi diam aja?

1. Konsep Utama Paling Penting
Zero Economy: Hapus semua logika soal budget, beli item, atau tebusan uang. Game ini 100% tentang Hitman yang menyusup dan menyandera warga secara diam-diam, sementara warga berusaha menebak siapa Hitman-nya lewat observasi chat.

2. Pembagian Role & Kemampuan
HITMAN (Jahat): Tugasnya menyandera semua orang. Saat Malam, dia memilih 1 korban untuk di- Hostage. Saat Siang, dia punya keahlian khusus Gag Order (bisa membungkam chat 1 orang, cooldown 1 ronde).
SPY (Warga - Pelindung): Tugasnya melindungi warga. Saat Malam, memilih 1 orang untuk dikawal (Guard). Jika orang itu diserang Hitman, aksi Hostage gagal. Syaratnya: tidak boleh mengawal orang yang sama 2 malam berturut-turut.
STALKER (Warga - Intel): Tugasnya mencari informasi. Saat Malam, bisa menerawang (Peek) identitas asli 1 pemain. Sangat OP, makanya punya cooldown lambat (cuma bisa dipakai 1x setiap 2 ronde).
CIVILIAN (Warga - Biasa): Tidak punya skill malam. Modalnya cuma berdebat di chat dan melakukan observasi siapa yang paling mencurigakan.

3. Alur Permainan Per Ronde (The Game Loop)
Fase Siang (Day - Diskusi): Semua orang berdebat di kolom chat selama sekian menit. Di momen ini, Hitman bisa diam-diam memencet tombol Gag Order untuk membisukan satu pemain secara mendadak demi menebar fitnah.
Fase Malam (Night - Aksi): Layar meredup, chat dikunci. Hitman menargetkan korban Hostage, Spy memasang tameng (Guard), dan Stalker mengintip identitas (Peek). Semua aksi dilakukan buta tanpa tahu pergerakan satu sama lain.
Fase Tribunal (Voting): Pagi tiba. Sistem akan merekap pergerakan semalam (tanpa menyebut nama target). Semua pemain yang masih bisa bicara akan melakukan voting. Pemain dengan vote terbanyak akan langsung dieksekusi mati oleh sistem. Ronde berulang.

4. Dua Mekanik Inti (Core Mechanics)
Efek Hostage: Korban yang sukses disandera oleh Hitman tidak mati di layar, tapi suaranya dihilangkan. Mereka sama sekali tidak bisa ngetik di chat dan hak voting-nya hangus.
Silent Terror: Sistem TIDAK PERNAH mengumumkan siapa yang kena Hostage. Kalau ada pemain yang tiba-tiba diam tidak membalas chat, pemain lain harus peka dan menebak: apakah dia kena Hostage, kena Gag Order, atau murni lagi diam aja?

1. Konsep Utama Paling Penting
Zero Economy: Hapus semua logika soal budget, beli item, atau tebusan uang. Game ini 100% tentang Hitman yang menyusup dan menyandera warga secara diam-diam, sementara warga berusaha menebak siapa Hitman-nya lewat observasi chat.

2. Pembagian Role & Kemampuan
HITMAN (Jahat): Tugasnya menyandera semua orang. Saat Malam, dia memilih 1 korban untuk di- Hostage. Saat Siang, dia punya keahlian khusus Gag Order (bisa membungkam chat 1 orang, cooldown 1 ronde).
SPY (Warga - Pelindung): Tugasnya melindungi warga. Saat Malam, memilih 1 orang untuk dikawal (Guard). Jika orang itu diserang Hitman, aksi Hostage gagal. Syaratnya: tidak boleh mengawal orang yang sama 2 malam berturut-turut.
STALKER (Warga - Intel): Tugasnya mencari informasi. Saat Malam, bisa menerawang (Peek) identitas asli 1 pemain. Sangat OP, makanya punya cooldown lambat (cuma bisa dipakai 1x setiap 2 ronde).
CIVILIAN (Warga - Biasa): Tidak punya skill malam. Modalnya cuma berdebat di chat dan melakukan observasi siapa yang paling mencurigakan.

3. Alur Permainan Per Ronde (The Game Loop)
Fase Siang (Day - Diskusi): Semua orang berdebat di kolom chat selama sekian menit. Di momen ini, Hitman bisa diam-diam memencet tombol Gag Order untuk membisukan satu pemain secara mendadak demi menebar fitnah.
Fase Malam (Night - Aksi): Layar meredup, chat dikunci. Hitman menargetkan korban Hostage, Spy memasang tameng (Guard), dan Stalker mengintip identitas (Peek). Semua aksi dilakukan buta tanpa tahu pergerakan satu sama lain.
Fase Tribunal (Voting): Pagi tiba. Sistem akan merekap pergerakan semalam (tanpa menyebut nama target). Semua pemain yang masih bisa bicara akan melakukan voting. Pemain dengan vote terbanyak akan langsung dieksekusi mati oleh sistem. Ronde berulang.

4. Dua Mekanik Inti (Core Mechanics)
Efek Hostage: Korban yang sukses disandera oleh Hitman tidak mati di layar, tapi suaranya dihilangkan. Mereka sama sekali tidak bisa ngetik di chat dan hak voting-nya hangus.
Silent Terror: Sistem TIDAK PERNAH mengumumkan siapa yang kena Hostage. Kalau ada pemain yang tiba-tiba diam tidak membalas chat, pemain lain harus peka dan menebak: apakah dia kena Hostage, kena Gag Order, atau murni lagi diam aja?

1. Konsep Utama Paling Penting
Zero Economy: Hapus semua logika soal budget, beli item, atau tebusan uang. Game ini 100% tentang Hitman yang menyusup dan menyandera warga secara diam-diam, sementara warga berusaha menebak siapa Hitman-nya lewat observasi chat.

2. Pembagian Role & Kemampuan
HITMAN (Jahat): Tugasnya menyandera semua orang. Saat Malam, dia memilih 1 korban untuk di- Hostage. Saat Siang, dia punya keahlian khusus Gag Order (bisa membungkam chat 1 orang, cooldown 1 ronde).
SPY (Warga - Pelindung): Tugasnya melindungi warga. Saat Malam, memilih 1 orang untuk dikawal (Guard). Jika orang itu diserang Hitman, aksi Hostage gagal. Syaratnya: tidak boleh mengawal orang yang sama 2 malam berturut-turut.
STALKER (Warga - Intel): Tugasnya mencari informasi. Saat Malam, bisa menerawang (Peek) identitas asli 1 pemain. Sangat OP, makanya punya cooldown lambat (cuma bisa dipakai 1x setiap 2 ronde).
CIVILIAN (Warga - Biasa): Tidak punya skill malam. Modalnya cuma berdebat di chat dan melakukan observasi siapa yang paling mencurigakan.

3. Alur Permainan Per Ronde (The Game Loop)
Fase Siang (Day - Diskusi): Semua orang berdebat di kolom chat selama sekian menit. Di momen ini, Hitman bisa diam-diam memencet tombol Gag Order untuk membisukan satu pemain secara mendadak demi menebar fitnah.
Fase Malam (Night - Aksi): Layar meredup, chat dikunci. Hitman menargetkan korban Hostage, Spy memasang tameng (Guard), dan Stalker mengintip identitas (Peek). Semua aksi dilakukan buta tanpa tahu pergerakan satu sama lain.
Fase Tribunal (Voting): Pagi tiba. Sistem akan merekap pergerakan semalam (tanpa menyebut nama target). Semua pemain yang masih bisa bicara akan melakukan voting. Pemain dengan vote terbanyak akan langsung dieksekusi mati oleh sistem. Ronde berulang.

4. Dua Mekanik Inti (Core Mechanics)
Efek Hostage: Korban yang sukses disandera oleh Hitman tidak mati di layar, tapi suaranya dihilangkan. Mereka sama sekali tidak bisa ngetik di chat dan hak voting-nya hangus.
Silent Terror: Sistem TIDAK PERNAH mengumumkan siapa yang kena Hostage. Kalau ada pemain yang tiba-tiba diam tidak membalas chat, pemain lain harus peka dan menebak: apakah dia kena Hostage, kena Gag Order, atau murni lagi diam aja?

1. Konsep Utama Paling Penting
Zero Economy: Hapus semua logika soal budget, beli item, atau tebusan uang. Game ini 100% tentang Hitman yang menyusup dan menyandera warga secara diam-diam, sementara warga berusaha menebak siapa Hitman-nya lewat observasi chat.

2. Pembagian Role & Kemampuan
HITMAN (Jahat): Tugasnya menyandera semua orang. Saat Malam, dia memilih 1 korban untuk di- Hostage. Saat Siang, dia punya keahlian khusus Gag Order (bisa membungkam chat 1 orang, cooldown 1 ronde).
SPY (Warga - Pelindung): Tugasnya melindungi warga. Saat Malam, memilih 1 orang untuk dikawal (Guard). Jika orang itu diserang Hitman, aksi Hostage gagal. Syaratnya: tidak boleh mengawal orang yang sama 2 malam berturut-turut.
STALKER (Warga - Intel): Tugasnya mencari informasi. Saat Malam, bisa menerawang (Peek) identitas asli 1 pemain. Sangat OP, makanya punya cooldown lambat (cuma bisa dipakai 1x setiap 2 ronde).
CIVILIAN (Warga - Biasa): Tidak punya skill malam. Modalnya cuma berdebat di chat dan melakukan observasi siapa yang paling mencurigakan.

3. Alur Permainan Per Ronde (The Game Loop)
Fase Siang (Day - Diskusi): Semua orang berdebat di kolom chat selama sekian menit. Di momen ini, Hitman bisa diam-diam memencet tombol Gag Order untuk membisukan satu pemain secara mendadak demi menebar fitnah.
Fase Malam (Night - Aksi): Layar meredup, chat dikunci. Hitman menargetkan korban Hostage, Spy memasang tameng (Guard), dan Stalker mengintip identitas (Peek). Semua aksi dilakukan buta tanpa tahu pergerakan satu sama lain.
Fase Tribunal (Voting): Pagi tiba. Sistem akan merekap pergerakan semalam (tanpa menyebut nama target). Semua pemain yang masih bisa bicara akan melakukan voting. Pemain dengan vote terbanyak akan langsung dieksekusi mati oleh sistem. Ronde berulang.

4. Dua Mekanik Inti (Core Mechanics)
Efek Hostage: Korban yang sukses disandera oleh Hitman tidak mati di layar, tapi suaranya dihilangkan. Mereka sama sekali tidak bisa ngetik di chat dan hak voting-nya hangus.
Silent Terror: Sistem TIDAK PERNAH mengumumkan siapa yang kena Hostage. Kalau ada pemain yang tiba-tiba diam tidak membalas chat, pemain lain harus peka dan menebak: apakah dia kena Hostage, kena Gag Order, atau murni lagi diam aja?

1. Konsep Utama Paling Penting
Zero Economy: Hapus semua logika soal budget, beli item, atau tebusan uang. Game ini 100% tentang Hitman yang menyusup dan menyandera warga secara diam-diam, sementara warga berusaha menebak siapa Hitman-nya lewat observasi chat.

2. Pembagian Role & Kemampuan
HITMAN (Jahat): Tugasnya menyandera semua orang. Saat Malam, dia memilih 1 korban untuk di- Hostage. Saat Siang, dia punya keahlian khusus Gag Order (bisa membungkam chat 1 orang, cooldown 1 ronde).
SPY (Warga - Pelindung): Tugasnya melindungi warga. Saat Malam, memilih 1 orang untuk dikawal (Guard). Jika orang itu diserang Hitman, aksi Hostage gagal. Syaratnya: tidak boleh mengawal orang yang sama 2 malam berturut-turut.
STALKER (Warga - Intel): Tugasnya mencari informasi. Saat Malam, bisa menerawang (Peek) identitas asli 1 pemain. Sangat OP, makanya punya cooldown lambat (cuma bisa dipakai 1x setiap 2 ronde).
CIVILIAN (Warga - Biasa): Tidak punya skill malam. Modalnya cuma berdebat di chat dan melakukan observasi siapa yang paling mencurigakan.

3. Alur Permainan Per Ronde (The Game Loop)
Fase Siang (Day - Diskusi): Semua orang berdebat di kolom chat selama sekian menit. Di momen ini, Hitman bisa diam-diam memencet tombol Gag Order untuk membisukan satu pemain secara mendadak demi menebar fitnah.
Fase Malam (Night - Aksi): Layar meredup, chat dikunci. Hitman menargetkan korban Hostage, Spy memasang tameng (Guard), dan Stalker mengintip identitas (Peek). Semua aksi dilakukan buta tanpa tahu pergerakan satu sama lain.
Fase Tribunal (Voting): Pagi tiba. Sistem akan merekap pergerakan semalam (tanpa menyebut nama target). Semua pemain yang masih bisa bicara akan melakukan voting. Pemain dengan vote terbanyak akan langsung dieksekusi mati oleh sistem. Ronde berulang.

4. Dua Mekanik Inti (Core Mechanics)
Efek Hostage: Korban yang sukses disandera oleh Hitman tidak mati di layar, tapi suaranya dihilangkan. Mereka sama sekali tidak bisa ngetik di chat dan hak voting-nya hangus.
Silent Terror: Sistem TIDAK PERNAH mengumumkan siapa yang kena Hostage. Kalau ada pemain yang tiba-tiba diam tidak membalas chat, pemain lain harus peka dan menebak: apakah dia kena Hostage, kena Gag Order, atau murni lagi diam aja?

2. Pembagian Role & Kemampuan
HITMAN (Jahat): Tugasnya menyandera semua orang. Saat Malam, dia memilih 1 korban untuk di- Hostage. Saat Siang, dia punya keahlian khusus Gag Order (bisa membungkam chat 1 orang, cooldown 1 ronde).
SPY (Warga - Pelindung): Tugasnya melindungi warga. Saat Malam, memilih 1 orang untuk dikawal (Guard). Jika orang itu diserang Hitman, aksi Hostage gagal. Syaratnya: tidak boleh mengawal orang yang sama 2 malam berturut-turut.
STALKER (Warga - Intel): Tugasnya mencari informasi. Saat Malam, bisa menerawang (Peek) identitas asli 1 pemain. Sangat OP, makanya punya cooldown lambat (cuma bisa dipakai 1x setiap 2 ronde).
CIVILIAN (Warga - Biasa): Tidak punya skill malam. Modalnya cuma berdebat di chat dan melakukan observasi siapa yang paling mencurigakan.

3. Alur Permainan Per Ronde (The Game Loop)
Fase Siang (Day - Diskusi): Semua orang berdebat di kolom chat selama sekian menit. Di momen ini, Hitman bisa diam-diam memencet tombol Gag Order untuk membisukan satu pemain secara mendadak demi menebar fitnah.
Fase Malam (Night - Aksi): Layar meredup, chat dikunci. Hitman menargetkan korban Hostage, Spy memasang tameng (Guard), dan Stalker mengintip identitas (Peek). Semua aksi dilakukan buta tanpa tahu pergerakan satu sama lain.
Fase Tribunal (Voting): Pagi tiba. Sistem akan merekap pergerakan semalam (tanpa menyebut nama target). Semua pemain yang masih bisa bicara akan melakukan voting. Pemain dengan vote terbanyak akan langsung dieksekusi mati oleh sistem. Ronde berulang.

4. Dua Mekanik Inti (Core Mechanics)
Efek Hostage: Korban yang sukses disandera oleh Hitman tidak mati di layar, tapi suaranya dihilangkan. Mereka sama sekali tidak bisa ngetik di chat dan hak voting-nya hangus.
Silent Terror: Sistem TIDAK PERNAH mengumumkan siapa yang kena Hostage. Kalau ada pemain yang tiba-tiba diam tidak membalas chat, pemain lain harus peka dan menebak: apakah dia kena Hostage, kena Gag Order, atau murni lagi diam aja?

Jangan melakukan refactor besar yang tidak diperlukan, jangan membuat duplicate implementation baru jika reusable pattern sudah tersedia, jangan menambahkan fallback palsu untuk menyembunyikan error sebenarnya, dan jangan memperluas scope hanya karena menemukan unrelated issue. Jangan melakukan refactor besar yang tidak diperlukan, jangan membuat duplicate implementation baru jika reusable pattern sudah tersedia, jangan menambahkan fallback palsu untuk menyembunyikan error sebenarnya, dan jangan memperluas scope hanya karena menemukan unrelated issue. Jika menemukan masalah di luar scope, catat sebagai finding terpisah tanpa ikut mengubahnya kecuali benar-benar menjadi blocker untuk fitur yang sedang di-QC. Setelah setiap fix, periksa seluruh caller/dependency yang terdampak agar perubahan tersebut tidak menciptakan regression baru.

Setelah seluruh temuan diperbaiki, lakukan **QC kedua dari awal seolah-olah kamu reviewer baru**. Jalankan semua validasi yang memang tersedia dan relevan di repository: unit/integration/e2e test, lint, type-check, build, targeted test, atau script validation lain yang aman dijalankan. Tambahkan atau perbaiki test jika terdapat critical behavior yang belum ter-cover, terutama untuk bug yang baru ditemukan, edge case penting, race condition, retry/idempotency, dan failure path. Jangan menyatakan suatu flow â€œverifiedâ€ jika hanya dibaca secara statis; bedakan dengan jelas antara static verification dan runtime verification. Jika ada bagian yang tidak dapat diuji karena membutuhkan credential, external service, environment, database, device, atau dependency tertentu, jangan mengarang hasilâ€”jelaskan apa yang belum bisa diuji, alasannya, risikonya, dan langkah verifikasi yang diperlukan.

Terakhir, lakukan final diff review dan pastikan tidak ada debug code, temporary flag, commented workaround, unused import, duplicate config, hardcoded value yang seharusnya shared/configurable, TODO kritis, inconsistent naming/type, secret, accidental logging, atau perubahan file yang tidak berkaitan. Hasil akhir harus berupa laporan yang spesifik dan dapat diaudit: scope yang diverifikasi, flow dan edge case yang diuji, temuan beserta root cause, perubahan yang dilakukan, file penting yang disentuh, command/test yang benar-benar dijalankan beserta hasilnya, limitation/residual risk, dan keputusan akhir **PASS / PASS WITH KNOWN LIMITATIONS / BLOCKED**. Jangan memberi status PASS hanya karena tidak menemukan error saat membaca code; PASS hanya jika implementasi sudah benar-benar cukup terverifikasi sesuai capability environment yang tersedia.

Jangan berasumsi code benar hanya karena compile, build, atau terlihat masuk akal; telusuri actual execution flow dari input/user action sampai hasil akhir dan pastikan tidak ada logic yang salah, duplikasi source of truth, konfigurasi yang bertentangan, dead code, insecure handling, coupling yang tidak perlu, behavior di luar requirement, atau implementasi yang diam-diam berbeda dari spec.

Lakukan QC secara aktif dengan mindset mencari kegagalan, bukan sekadar mencari alasan untuk PASS. Periksa happy path, invalid input, null/undefined, empty data, malformed payload/response, missing/invalid ID, unsupported value, timeout, network failure, partial failure, repeated action, double-click/double-submit, duplicate request, refresh/reload, navigation away, browser back/forward, stale state, race condition, async completion yang datang tidak berurutan, component unmount, retry, recovery, caching, pagination/limit, persistence, dan kondisi ketika satu bagian berhasil tetapi bagian berikutnya gagal. Pastikan tidak ada duplicate data, duplicate transaction, false success, silent failure, infinite loading, stale result, inconsistent state, orphan record, data loss, unhandled rejection, console/runtime error, unauthorized access, data leakage, atau kondisi di mana UI dan backend menunjukkan state yang berbeda. Periksa juga seluruh button, form, input, modal, dropdown, navigation, API request, loading/error/success/empty state, responsive behavior, access control, direct URL access, dan seluruh config/environment yang digunakan oleh scope tersebut.

Audit security dan data integrity secara khusus. Jangan mempercayai nilai penting hanya karena dikirim frontend; ownership, authorization, status, price/cost, privileged field, identifier, dan business rule penting harus diverifikasi di server/layer authoritative yang tepat. Pastikan tidak ada secret, credential, token, sensitive internal error, atau private data yang terekspos ke client atau log. Periksa juga idempotency, transaction boundary, failure semantics, retry behavior, concurrent request, dan consistency antara database/backend/frontend bila relevan. Jika ada operasi berbayar, irreversible, destructive, atau stateful, pastikan retry maupun transport failure tidak secara tidak sengaja menggandakan efeknya. Jangan menghapus validation/security atau melemahkan test hanya supaya fitur terlihat bekerja.

Untuk setiap bug, celah, missing handling, atau konfigurasi salah yang masih berada dalam scope, lakukan **root-cause analysis lalu langsung perbaiki** dengan perubahan sekecil, seaman, dan sekonsisten mungkin terhadap existing codebase. Jangan melakukan refactor besar yang tidak diperlukan, jangan membuat duplicate implementation baru jika reusable pattern sudah tersedia, jangan menambahkan fallback palsu untuk menyembunyikan error sebenarnya, dan jangan memperluas scope hanya karena menemukan unrelated issue. Jika menemukan masalah di luar scope, catat sebagai finding terpisah tanpa ikut mengubahnya kecuali benar-benar menjadi blocker untuk fitur yang sedang di-QC. Setelah setiap fix, periksa seluruh caller/dependency yang terdampak agar perubahan tersebut tidak menciptakan regression baru.

Setelah seluruh temuan diperbaiki, lakukan **QC kedua dari awal seolah-olah kamu reviewer baru**. Jalankan semua validasi yang memang tersedia dan relevan di repository: unit/integration/e2e test, lint, type-check, build, targeted test, atau script validation lain yang aman dijalankan. Tambahkan atau perbaiki test jika terdapat critical behavior yang belum ter-cover, terutama untuk bug yang baru ditemukan, edge case penting, race condition, retry/idempotency, dan failure path. Jangan menyatakan suatu flow â€œverifiedâ€ jika hanya dibaca secara statis; bedakan dengan jelas antara static verification dan runtime verification. Jika ada bagian yang tidak dapat diuji karena membutuhkan credential, external service, environment, database, device, atau dependency tertentu, jangan mengarang hasilâ€”jelaskan apa yang belum bisa diuji, alasannya, risikonya, dan langkah verifikasi yang diperlukan.

Terakhir, lakukan final diff review dan pastikan tidak ada debug code, temporary flag, commented workaround, unused import, duplicate config, hardcoded value yang seharusnya shared/configurable, TODO kritis, inconsistent naming/type, secret, accidental logging, atau perubahan file yang tidak berkaitan. Hasil akhir harus berupa laporan yang spesifik dan dapat diaudit: scope yang diverifikasi, flow dan edge case yang diuji, temuan beserta root cause, perubahan yang dilakukan, file penting yang disentuh, command/test yang benar-benar dijalankan beserta hasilnya, limitation/residual risk, dan keputusan akhir **PASS / PASS WITH KNOWN LIMITATIONS / BLOCKED**. Jangan memberi status PASS hanya karena tidak menemukan error saat membaca code; PASS hanya jika implementasi sudah benar-benar cukup terverifikasi sesuai capability environment yang tersedia.

1. Konsep Utama Paling Penting
Zero Economy: Hapus semua logika soal budget, beli item, atau tebusan uang. Game ini 100% tentang Hitman yang menyusup dan menyandera warga secara diam-diam, sementara warga berusaha menebak siapa Hitman-nya lewat observasi chat.

2. Pembagian Role & Kemampuan
HITMAN (Jahat): Tugasnya menyandera semua orang. Saat Malam, dia memilih 1 korban untuk di- Hostage. Saat Siang, dia punya keahlian khusus Gag Order (bisa membungkam chat 1 orang, cooldown 1 ronde).
SPY (Warga - Pelindung): Tugasnya melindungi warga. Saat Malam, memilih 1 orang untuk dikawal (Guard). Jika orang itu diserang Hitman, aksi Hostage gagal. Syaratnya: tidak boleh mengawal orang yang sama 2 malam berturut-turut.
STALKER (Warga - Intel): Tugasnya mencari informasi. Saat Malam, bisa menerawang (Peek) identitas asli 1 pemain. Sangat OP, makanya punya cooldown lambat (cuma bisa dipakai 1x setiap 2 ronde).
CIVILIAN (Warga - Biasa): Tidak punya skill malam. Modalnya cuma berdebat di chat dan melakukan observasi siapa yang paling mencurigakan.

3. Alur Permainan Per Ronde (The Game Loop)
Fase Siang (Day - Diskusi): Semua orang berdebat di kolom chat selama sekian menit. Di momen ini, Hitman bisa diam-diam memencet tombol Gag Order untuk membisukan satu pemain secara mendadak demi menebar fitnah.
Fase Malam (Night - Aksi): Layar meredup, chat dikunci. Hitman menargetkan korban Hostage, Spy memasang tameng (Guard), dan Stalker mengintip identitas (Peek). Semua aksi dilakukan buta tanpa tahu pergerakan satu sama lain.
Fase Tribunal (Voting): Pagi tiba. Sistem akan merekap pergerakan semalam (tanpa menyebut nama target). Semua pemain yang masih bisa bicara akan melakukan voting. Pemain dengan vote terbanyak akan langsung dieksekusi mati oleh sistem. Ronde berulang.

4. Dua Mekanik Inti (Core Mechanics)
Efek Hostage: Korban yang sukses disandera oleh Hitman tidak mati di layar, tapi suaranya dihilangkan. Mereka sama sekali tidak bisa ngetik di chat dan hak voting-nya hangus.
Silent Terror: Sistem TIDAK PERNAH mengumumkan siapa yang kena Hostage. Kalau ada pemain yang tiba-tiba diam tidak membalas chat, pemain lain harus peka dan menebak: apakah dia kena Hostage, kena Gag Order, atau murni lagi diam aja?
